tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar 'phrin las rgya mtsho

rnam par rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti pra dza bh+yaḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mgon po stag lung ba chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma mchog gi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus thams cad du brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ dpal ldan mchog tu rtag brtan gzhom med sku/ /brjod bral sgra dbyangs kun la 'jug 'gyur gsung*/ /lhun 'grub bde stong ji snyed gzigs pa'i thugs/ /'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad khyod phyag gi gnas/ /rab brtan byang chub sems kyi gzhir/ /rmad byung phan bde'i lo tog dag /mtha' yas bskal bar mi zad pa/ /bskrun mdzad bla ma mchog 'di rgyal/ /e yig kun ldan stong pa'i khrir/ /waṃ yig bde chen rang rgyal po/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes rang bzhin dngos/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud/ /thog med rdzu 'phrul bsgrod pa can/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin dpag yas kyi/ /'phrin las kun khyab gar yang son/ /sgyu 'phrul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gags med gzhom du med pa'i tshul/ /brjod bral sgra dbyangs thams cad pa/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin 'jug /'gro mgon gsung la phyag bgyi'o/ /rang bzhin dag pa rnam mi rtog /lhun 'grub 'bad rtsol bral ba'i dbyings/ /ji lta ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs/ /rje btsun thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 'gro kuna~X dga~X' ba'i bkra~X shisa~X chos sgo rab gsal thar pa'i rgyala~X mtsha~Xn dpa~Xl ldan snying rje bza~Xng po~X can/ /kuna~X nas dga~X' bas mtha' bral stong nyid bkra~X shi~Xs lam mchog rgya~Xl ba'i mtsha~Xn gyi dpa~Xl 'bar kun tu bzang po'i lam/ /skal ldan kun la dga' bzhi'i lam ston bkra shis bdud las rgyal ba'i mtshan mchog srid zhi'i dpal yon bza~Xng po~X pa/ /ku~Xn tu rab dga~X' bkra~X shi~Xs rtsibs stong rab bkra zhabs bzung chos kyi rgyala~X mtsha~Xn skye 'gro'i dpa~Xl gyur bza~Xng po~Xr 'dud/

/chad pa med pa'i dus kyi mtha' yang mngon par byang chub zag bral 'gyur med dus kyi nges pa ste/ /slar yang nges par mtha' yas khams su ngo mtshar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed mdzad pa rgya chen dang*/ /gzhan du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dang kha cig tu ni nyan thos de bzhin rang byang chub pa'i tshul/ /'phrog byed mes po sred med bu dang mi sbyin rgyas pa dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo bum pa bzang*/ /tha dad yi ge dang ni rigs byed sna tshogs rigs sngags gzhan yang chu bo gzing dang zam pa sogs/ /'byung ba 'byung 'gyur sems can khams te mtha' dag gzugs kyis sprul pa sgyu ma'i drwa ba mdzad pa 'dir/ /rtog ge'i blo gros sna tshogs tshig gis 'jug pa'i go skabs nam yang ma mchis tshangs sogs lha rnams kyang*/ /byol song nyid bzhin lung dang rig pa'i khengs ldan dag kyang mu cor rang bzhin byas pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /de slad bla ma mchog rjes bzung gang khengs btang ste/ /rab tu ye shes bdud rtsi cung zad rnyed gyur na/ /gnas 'di yon tan rgya mtsho yin zhes shes gyur gyi/ /rang bzor dpyad pas nyams pa'i ri bo 'di dag rmongs/ /gang gi drin gyis bskyed pa'i chu skyes dga'/ /tshig snyan ze'u 'bru rgyas pas nyer brgyan mod/ /log pa'i kun rtog ge sar rdul rgyas pa'i/ /thugs mtsho rnyog byed de yang mgon khyod kyi/ /thugs rjes byang chub bar du rjes bzung nas/ /gnod pa las kyang bde ba'i 'bras 'dir mtshar/ /blo zhan phan chen btags pa'ang 'bras med de/ /dam par gnod pa'i lan yang phan par spyod/ / rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshul 'dzin pa/ /'dren pa 'dren mchog rnams kyis gus btud cing*/ /blo ldan blo gros chen po'i lam ston pa/ /gsung mchog gsung gi bdag po khyed la bstod/ khyod kyi yon tan 'phrin las ni/ /bsam mi khyab ces 'dir ston gyi/ /re re nas brjod ngal ba ni/

/dpyod ldan rnams kyis ci phyir brten/ /de la kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa don gyis slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun dam pa a nan+da maṅga la zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa 'di nyid ni/ shes dang shes bya gcig pu'i sku/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi bdag nyid/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin sku bzhi'i ngo bor/ ye shes lnga'i rnam rol/ rgyu drug gi 'gro ba sgrol bar mdzad pa/ 'jig rten bdun las yongs su 'das pa'i zhing khams can 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad ston pa/ yan lag dgu dang ldan pa'i gsungs rab kyi sgra sgrog pa/ sa bcu rnam par gnon pa'i dbang phyugabaden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*/ de nyid rnam par bcu drug zung du 'jug pa/ rnam pa nyi shus mngon par byang chub pa/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus nye bar brgyan pa/ rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor spro ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snang brnyan chad pa med pa'i zhing rnams su mu mtha' med pa'i bskal par brjod du med pa'i tshul gyis 'jug par bya'o/ / zhes brjod par bya'o/ /tha snyad kyi tshad mas ni gzhal mi spyod do/ /'on kyang cung zad thos pa dag cig gleng na/ grub mchog stong gis zhabs zung nyer mchod pa/ / mchog gyur mkhas pa lnga brgyas gus pas mchod/ /phyogs bzhis mu stegs pham mdzad mkha' la gshegs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs par bzung*/ /'jam dbyangs rang nyid 'jam dbyangs sras po'i tshul/ /srid gsum sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad pa'i lha/ /byang chub sems dpa' lam bzang spyod pa'i mchog /srid gsum phyogs bcur gsal bar mdzad ces thos/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs kyi sras 'jam dpal nyid kyis sprul par grags pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha zhes bya ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyis mu stegs thams cad btul zhing*/ mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis theg chen gyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad cing*/

rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad de zung 'jug 'ja' lus kyi sku brnyes pa des/ gangs ri'i khrod du yang srid bzung ba'i tshul mdzad pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal yin te/ ༈ dal 'byor nor 'dzin lhag bsam ljon pa'i brgyan/ /byang chub sems kyi yal 'dab phyogs bcu rgyas/ /don gnyis 'bras bzang mngon par brdol ba 'dis/ /srid pa'i 'gro ba thams cad mgron du gnyer/ /dam pa 'di ni bdag bas gzhan gces ky-i thugs bcos ma ma yin la chung ngu'i dus nas mnga' zhing*/ gzhan gyis ma bstan par pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'jug pa la sogs pa byang sems 'phags pa'i chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sogs pa so so skye bo phal gyi mthun snang du grub par mnga' ba/ lung rig smra ba'i dbang phyug yin zhing*/ rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i tshul mdzad de/ lo rgyus rgyas par gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yongs su khyab pa'i rnam thar rnams su shes par bya'o/ / gzhan yang theg chen chos kyi rgyal po yang*/ dam pa 'di nyid dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan don rtags dang bcas pa mang du snang ngo*/ /gang 'di sa chen dam chos dang*/ /srid kyi phun sum tshogs mdzad pa/ /'di lta gzhan ni ma mchis te/ / theg chen chos kyi rgyal por gyur/ /de tshe 'jungs ldan chen po 'gas/ /rang gi rdzas kyis rang nyid bcom/ /gang 'di chos 'byor 'phel ba dang*/ /yun ring 'tsho zhing bzhes pa lags/ /de ltar rim par brgyud de slar yang dbu ru byang phyogs 'dir/ rtogs ldan bsod nams dbang phyug ces bya bar skye ba bzhes te/ mgul gyi ngos la dpa' bo'i rtags mtshan rme ba dmar pos mtshan pa las dpag te/ skye bo rnams kyis byu ru ske zhes bla dwags su mtshan gsol ba zhig ste/ de ni grub lung gi ri khrod du gtso bor bzhugs pa/ shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin zha ི nga*/ myur mdzad mgon po dang mi lab pa bzhin yod pa/

rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing*/ sgrib pa med pa'i mngon shes kyis lung ston pa sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ shes cher mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i bya rog dang lhan cig rtsed mo mdzad cing*/ nyid kyis mda' chung ngu 'phen par mdzad par bya rog gis gshog pa brkyangs nas len par mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar gyis rol ba mtha' yas pa ston pa yod par snang ngo*/ / dpag yas rdzu 'phrul rol rtsed la/ /shin tu ngo mtshar 'gyur ba ci/ /sgron me gtams la 'od gsal ba/ /spyi lugs 'di la ci zhig dpyod/ / 'on kyang thugs rje'i ri mo rnam bkra ba/ /ji bzhin lta byed dag pa'i mig 'di mtshar/ / rgyal ba'i ye shes yis kyang gzhal dka' ba'i/ /rnam thar mthong ba 'di yang de yis mthu/ / ༈ de nyid nas sku yi skye ba bar ma chad pa byon pa ni rje btsun 'di yin no/ /rnam 'dren gser gyi 'dab rgyas stong gis rab brgyan pa'i/ /zhing bzang bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho mi mjed ces grags pa/ /gang 'di'i rgyun gyur go tam rigs 'khrungs shākya'i sras/ /legs 'khrungs 'dzam bu'i sgra ldan dbyig 'dzin snying po 'di/ /shes bya'i gnas la thogs med mthu ldan dang*/ /dngos grub lang tsho rgyas pa'i skal bzang can/ /rgyu skar grangs kyis nye bar mi dpog pas/ / lan brgyar phyag byas srid gsum ma lus pa/ /kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur mngon mchod cing*/ /rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor lo bsgyur gcig pu/ /bde chen lam gyis mngon par byang chub pa/ /sa bdag mi dbang in+ḍa bhu ti ste/ /ma rig spyod pa'i 'dam rdzab las ring du/ /rab grol bsod nams gzi 'od brgya 'bar 'di/ /rgyal srid legs byas dbang gi ring mo nas/ /srid pa'i nags su 'bad rtsol bral bas rnyed/ /rgyal po chos bzhin spyod pa'i tshe/ khang bzang rtse mo nyer brten pas/ /dgra bcom dge slong mchod 'os rnams/ /bla gos 'char ka'i snang ba yi/

/zhing 'di'i mun pa kun 'joms shing*/ /phyogs grol bde ba'i lam yangs las/ /'ong zhing 'gro ba mthong ba na/ /sngon bsags legs byas shing rta yis/ /yid mkhar dad pa'i 'od stong drangs/ /de nas rgyal la dad pa yis/ / mchod bcas gsol ba btab par gyur/ /mngon shes drug gi spyan ldan gang*/ / srid 'di'i phun tshogs thams cad kyis/ /nyer brgyan 'khor bcas lha yi lam/ /go skabs dman pas nyer byon tshe/ /mchod pa'i ya mtshan ci yang sprul/ / gnyis med gsungs la mi dbang gis/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyu zhes pas/ /sa bdag rab tu byung nas ni/ /bslab gsum rin chen zung zhig gsungs/ /de zhus bskal pa brgya yis ni/ /don chen 'grub la ngo mtshar ci/ /bcom ldan gyis ni 'bad gyur na/ /ri rgyal thal bar byed ces mchi/ /zas gcod bsnyun dang gtar dpyad sogs/ /ngal ba 'bum gyis nad bsal yang*/ /grags pa'i 'byor pa dman pa des/ /sman dang sman pa nyid tshor byas/ /'bad med bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /bdud rtsis 'bras bu nad 'phrog byed/ /rigs sngags kho nas nad 'joms sogs/ /sngags dang sman 'di ya mtshan rmad/ /goms pa'i sems ni bzlog dka' bas/ /rgyal ba khyed ni thams casad mkhyen/ /de phyir 'dod pas byang chub mchog /thob 'gyur gang yin bdag la gsungs/ /de nas ngur smrig thun mtshams kyi/ /dmar 'od rnam par nyams las slar/ /dpag yas dkyil 'khor 'od dkar brgya/ /rab spros gang sku'i zla ba ni/ /rig ma ri bong mtshan mas 'khyud/ /rig 'dzin rgyu skar tshogs bcas shar/ /des der mi bdag dbang bskur nas/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes ze'u 'bru rgyas/ /mtha' dag gsang sngags mdangs bkra ba'i/ /rig 'dzin 'dab rgya'i g.yogs pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang ba de yis ni/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i gsang sngags mdzod/ /mtha' dag bzung zhing mngon bstan pas/ /mi dang mi min kun grol te/ /grog sbur rdo rje 'dzin thob na/ /de las gzhan pa ci zhig gtam/

/phyi nas yun ring 'das pa'i 'og /o rgyan zhes pa'i yul mchog der/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po ste/ /slar yang mi bdag tshul bzung nas/ /lwa ba'i zhabs dang mtsho skyes zhabs/ /lhan cig sngags kyi lam ston zha ི nga*/ /mtha' yas skye bos dngos grub thob/ /de nas phy-i ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /slar yang mkha' 'gro'i gling mchog der/ / sa bdag dbang po'i blon gyur nas/ /rdo rje theg pa rgyas bstan te/ /sngags rgyud mkha' dang mnyam par byas/ /de ltar na dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang ba gsang sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba'i slad du/ mi yi bdag po'i tshul bzung iṇ+ḍa bhu ti zhes pa'i mtshan 'chang ba lan gsum byon pa lags te/ de nyid shin tu snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba dmu rgod rnams 'dul ba'i slad du/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal po zhes grags pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i skur nye bar bstan pa ste/ 'gro ba'i mgon po nyid kyis/ rjes thang pa rin po bkra shis dpal la bka' bstsal par yang*/ iṇ+ḍa bhu ti gsum byung ba la thog mtha' gnyis nga yin/ bar ma khyod yin/ lar gsum ka ngo bo gcig ces gsungs te/ de'i phyir 'gro ba'i mgon po 'di'i rnam par sprul ba ni/ ji skad du/ rgyud las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*/ /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag nyid kyi drung du gnas pa chos las 'khrungs pa'i sras kyi thu bor mngon par dbang bskur ba 'gro mgon stag lung thang pa chen po bkra shis dpal zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa 'di nyid yin te/ 'di nyid gcig pur ma zad/ dpal stag lung thang gi seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'khod pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi gnas brnyes pa mtha' dag kyang sprul pa dang yang sprul dang sum sprul dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sprul pa'i tshul gyi sku tha dad par bstan pa tsam ma gtogs ngo bo tha dad par mi bsam mo/

/de yang ye shes chen po gcig pu gnyis su med pa'i zlos gar las/ 'gro ba'i don rgya cher spyod pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa mchog gi tshul bzung ba/ so so'i skye bo rnams kyi snang ngor zhing dang gdul bya tha dad par snang ba can/ gzhal bar mi spyod pa'i snang brnyan/ brgyud pa nas brgyud par rang byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin lags te/ nam mkha' zla ba gcig pu shar ba'i tshe yul dang gnas tha dad pa'i chu bo/ rgya mtsho rdzing bu/ ldeng ka snod kyi chu tha dad pa rnams dang*/ sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba'i chu thigs gcig tshun chad la yang de nyid kyis gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin no/ /des na bdag cag gi rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di yang*/ mnyam med thang pa chen po nyid dang thugs gnyis su med par nges shing*/ de nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'am/ rgyal po chen po iṇ+ḍa bhu ti dang mi gnyis pa'i rang bzhin can dang*/ yang gcig tu na/ skal bzang gi 'dren pa stong gi thog ma bde bar gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig nyid yin par yang gyur te/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo grub pa nyid kyi bka' yang dag pa'i tshad mas grub pa nyid yin no/ /der ma zad rgyal sras zhi ba lha ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis rnam par sprul pa yin pa dang*/ dpal stag lung thang pa chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis rnam 'phrul te/ rgyal ba'i sras po chen po thogs med bzang po dpal de nyid kyang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ye shes chen po'i rnam 'phrul du grags shing grub pa'i phyir kho bo cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs spyi'i gzugs rgyal ba'i sras po gzhon nu'i sku 'chang ba 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang*/ thugs rje chen po phyag na pad+mo can dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje gsum char gyi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul gcig pu ste/ de dag mi 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan yang*/

rigs gsum gyi sems dpa' 'di rnams lhas sbyin dang mchod sbyin ltar rgyud tha dad pa ni ma yin te/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi spyi gzugs chen po yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdo rje gang yin pa de nyid gsung dang thugs kyang yin pa'i phyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas 'dir ni/ rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas/ mchog tu gus pa chen pos chad pa med pa'i dus kyi mthar/ zhing gi rdul snyed du rnam par sprul pa'i lus kyis phyag 'tshal bar rigs kyi mkhas pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ rtog ge'i rig pas 'jug pa ni nyag phran gyi rtse mos chu gter gyi gting mtha' tshol ba bzhin no/ /smras pa/ chos rnams rang bzhin mkha' 'dra gzhal du med/ /ye shes rang bzhin mkha' 'dra gzhal du med/ /sgo gsum mdzad pa mkha' 'dra gzhal du med/ /rnam 'phrul 'jug pa mkha' 'dra gzhal du med/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gnas 'di la/ /bdag cag dad pas rtogs bya yi/ /shes rab dman pa'i me khyer gyis/ /mdzad pa'i 'jig rten ji ltar gsal/ /srid gsum 'jig rten bdun la sogs/ /'khor 'das chos rnams rang bzhin ni/ /gnyis med brjod bral bsam du med/ /rnam pa ma 'gags cir yang snang*/ /rang bzhin gsal stong 'gags med phyir/ /rang bzhin 'bras bu mngon gyur pa'i/ /rnam thar brjod bral bsam yas 'di/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'i rgyu/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*/ /nam mkha' las byung nam mkha'i dngos/ /phyogs rnams kun tu nam mkha' bzhin/ /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /'byung ba 'di dag bsam med cing*/ /'bad rtsol med pa phyogs bcu yis/ /sems can kun gyi nyer 'tshe dang*/ /rang rang las la ma 'dres 'jug /ji ltar sa rdul tshad med

pa/ /rang rang ma 'dres bya ba la/ /rnam rtog med cing 'jug gyur pa/ /mgon khyod 'phrin las de dang mtshungs/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho rlabs g.yo ba/ /chu rlabs rnam 'gyur tha dad cing*/ /rang bzhin rgya mtsho gcig pur 'jug /rgyal khyod rgya mtsho dang mtshungs te/ /mgon po kun gzhi gnas gyur brnyes/ /rang bzhin mi shes byis pa rnams/ /chu rlabs rgya mtsho ji bzhin du/ /dbyings dang rnam 'phrul so sor rtogs/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig /shar bas sa gzhi ri bcas kun/ /cig car snang bar byed gyur cing*/ /las rnams sna tshogs byed gyur te/ / lo thog smin par byed pa dang*/ /skem dang rgyas dang 'ju ba dang*/ /pad+ma la sogs kha 'byed pa/ /'di la rnam par rtog pa med/ /pad+ma'i mtsho dang zhing sa dang*/ /nyi ma'i 'jug bya gzhan dang gzhan/ /gang rnams de dag kun la ni/ / 'od zer gcig 'jug tha dad med/ /nyid kyi ye shes 'jug pa yang*/ /gcig pu 'jig rten 'dir shar bas/ /mos pa so so'i sems can gyi/ /bsam pa tha dad sna tshogs 'jug /bsam gyis mi khyab gnas 'di la/ /'jug sel dbyig gi snying po dang*/ /ral pa can yang phyugs dang mtshungs/ /pa nata pa nata gzhon nu dang*/ /rgyas pa grogs mkhar i gi ras/ /mi byin ser skya mar kan ṭe/ /ne tso 'od srung kā ta'i bu/ /de dag rgyu ma'i shin tu 'khor/ /mgon po khyod kyi gnas 'di ni/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba kho nas mkhyen/ /sa 'di rgyu dang mi rgyu kun/ /rten zhing gnas pa'i gzhi yin pa/ /de bzhin brtan g.yo thams cad kyi/ /bskyed ma gzhi ni mgon khyod lags/ /yon tan thams cad bskyed mdzad pa'i/ /zla med sa gzhi khyod la 'dud/ /mgon po khyod mtshungs phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ste/ khyod nyid rgyal ba lags pas dpe ma rnyed/ /dpe med mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems khyod phyag gi gnas/ /'di dag ni sngon gyi sku'i skyed rabs la brtsams te dam pa'i yon tan ci rigs pa bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te dang po'o//

//da ni sku'i skye ba 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshul so so'i skye bo dag la thun mong du snang ba zhig brjod par bya ste/ de la gang du sku'i skye ba bzung ba'i yul ni/ tha snyad 'jig rten gyi gtsug lag la/ yongs su grags pa'i dge bcu'i lus yongs su rdzogs shing*/ khyad par du yang bde ba 'byor pa skye bo mang pos yongs su gang ba/ yul tha dad pa'i skye bo mtha' yas pa'i rang rang gi zong dang 'dod dgu'i longs spyod thams cad mngon par thogs te lang long tu rgyu bas ra ba dang srang thams cad mdzes par byas pa/ skye bo thams cad kyang gcig tu dge ba la mngon par dga' zhing*/ sku gzugs dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ glegs bam dang*/ dge 'dun dag la lta ci smos/ ngur smrig gi rtags cung zad tsam 'chang ba la yang bdag cag gi yon gnas dam pa'o/ /zhes lan brgyar phyag bgyid pa sogs dad pa'i nor gyis phyug pa/ yul 'khor thams cad chos smra ba 'khor dang bcas pas yongs su gang ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khud pa/ 'phan yul rigs pa'i 'byung gnas sa'i cha/ spras zhes bya ba'i yul 'jig rten gsum gyi dge legs thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang chen po ste/ der dam pa 'di'i yab tu gyur pa ni/ dpal stag lung thang pa chen po'i dpon gyi rigs/ rigs sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ chos bzhin pas sa skyong ba'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' chen po bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di nyid kyang lhag pa'i lha bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje phur pa sa lugs dang*/ bde mchog lhan skyes dang*/ mahā ka la tsa tur bhu dza'i bzlas brjod kyi mthar son zhing*/ skye 'gro gdon gyis gtses pa la sngags 'debs pa dang*/ byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis nad gdon ma lus pa zhi bar 'gyur ba sogs byin rlabs kyi gzi byin lhag par rgyas pa/ 'bangs rnams thams cad bde bar bskyangs bas thams cad kyis kyang pha ma'am/

mkhan po'am/ slob dpon mchog gi bzhin du gus pas blta ba/ 'thab pa dang rtsod pa med par byams pa'i ngang tshul kho nas 'gran zla thams cad kyang gus pas 'dud par byed pa zhig ste/ yum du gyur pa ni sde pa chen po dga' ba'i sras mo bde~X skyida~X bu~X 'dre~Xn zhes bya ba ji skad bshad pa'i bud med kyi skyon thams cad ni spangs/ yon tan thams cad kyi mngon par brgyan pa ste/ rigs dang*/ gzugs dang*/ blo gros dang*/ 'byor ba dang bsod nams kyi dpal dang ldan pa sgo gsum shin tu bsrung ba'i rang bzhin can zhig ste/ yab yum gnyis la sras lnga dang lcam gnyis te/ mched bdun gyi rting ma bdun pa ni dam pa 'di yin te/ me pho sprel 'u'i lo la dge mtshan thams cad kyis mngon par spras te sku bltams so/ /de yang rje 'di nyid lhums su zhugs pa nas brtsams te/ chab 'og thams cad bde zhing lo legs pa dang*/ dge mtshan gyi ltas 'ga' zhig gong nas gong du mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur zhing*/ sku bltams pa na yang yum la gnod pa med cing*/ me tog gi char 'babs pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas gzhal du med pa 'jig rten 'dir 'byung ngo*/ /༈ sum rtsen gnas pa'i dge mtshan kun/ /sa steng 'jig rten 'dir 'phos pa/ /bsod nams mthu las mngon 'grub kyi/ /rgyu gzhan dag gis ga la zhig /mdongs mtha'i 'dab mas mchog tu legs brgyan pa/ /mar gad zhi ba 'khyil 'dra'i nor 'dzin nam/ /srid gsum mdzes pa'i yon tan kun mdzes te/ /skyon med gnas kyi mdzes sdug thams cad 'phrogs/ /ljon shing bu mo gnyen lcug lo 'dab bgos/ /rab 'bar me tog mchog dga'i mig gi zer/ / phyogs kun zur mig g.yo ldan bcud bzang 'bras/ /nu rgyas 'dod pa'i longs spyod dag gis mdzes/ /rnam bkra grong khyer ba dan brgyan spras pa/ /nyi zla skar bcas sa la 'khod pa snyam/ /'phrog byed dga' ma'i dbyangs kyi rjes snyeg pa/

/ sgra 'di khyad par 'phags phyir sum rtsen grong/ /mkhar nyal rnams ni bag med chang gis myos/ /legs byas bdud rtsis rol pas 'di nyid mchog /rgyal khyod dgyes rol 'di nyid 'og min te/ /gzhan nas tshol ba'i ngal ba deng 'dir zad/ /rgyal ba yum kun shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dmigs med thugs rje gang yin deng 'dir yab/ /rdo rje'i sku la srid pa'i pha ma med/ /'gro ba'i mgon po sprul ba'i sgyu ma mdzad/ /de nas sku bltams ma thag dpal stag lung thang pa chen po rje rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi snyan du phul zhing mtshan gnang bar zhus pas/ mchog tu dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal dang bcas/ bkra shis don 'grub zhes mtshan don dang ldan pa gsol zhing*/ bsrung skud dang gtor ma'i byin rlabs sogs kyang zab rgyas su bstsal/ ma ma rnams kyis gtsang sbra'i spyod lam dang ldan pa'i sku bskyed bsrings pas mtsho'i nang gi pad+ma'am/ char chu rgyas pa'i chu bo'am/ zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du gang sku'i lang tsho mchog tu mngon par brtas par gyur/ de nas smra mkhyen tsam na yang sku'i rtse grogs gzhan dag gi srog chags la 'tshe ba sogs sdig pa'i las la spyod pa dag che thang du bzlog par mdzad cing*/ ma ṇi bzlas pa la sogs chos spyod dang dge ba'i rim pa la bdag nyid rtsol zhing gzhan yang bskul bar mdzad pa dang sku chas phra mo tshun chad kyang so so la sbyin par mdzad pa dang*/ skabs gzhan dang gzhan du sa stegs dang khri'u dag la mngon par 'khod nas/ chos 'chad pa dang dbang bskur ba ltar mdzad pa dang*/ res 'ga' ni sku lus gnad dang ldan pas nang la mchog tu gzhol ba ltar yang mdzad nas/ mdor na 'di ni ma bstan par sbyin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba dang*/ don mthun pa dang*/ don spyod pa sde bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la 'jug pa zhes/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos yin par 'phags pa rnam par 'phrul pas zhus pa'i mdo las byung ba bzhin yin no/

/ gzhan yang mdzad pa thams cad chos kyis mdzad pa 'ba' zhig gi bag chags sad pas/ bskang gso dang*/ gtor bzlog dang*/ sgrub mchod kyi tshul mdzad pa dang*/ 'khor tshogs kyi skye bo mang pos bsti stangs dang bcas pa'i tshul du zhugs par mdzad pa sogs byung ste/ mdor na de dag kun ni phyis kyi 'phrin las kyi rten 'brel du gyur pa 'dra zhes shes ldan rnams kyis gleng ngo*/ /de na so so skye bo rnams kyis rang gi blos rgyas bkab kyis sku'i spyod lam bsrangs su 'jug pa'i bsam pas nan tur gyi tshul du 'bul bar byed pa na/ de skad du ngam shod phye ma'i dkyil na mi mo zhig /rgyal blon rgyal srid skyong ba'i bya ba las/ /ma smad 'khrug pa bsdum nas byar dga' 'ong*/ /rgyal blon blo re chung zhes zer ba thos/ / zhes pa'i dpe dang 'dra' 'o snyam du sems so/ /de skabs su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dngos su byin gyis rlabs pa'i 'khon rigs dam pa mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi dbang phyug bdag chen rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug dang*/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgrub brgyud 'gran zla dang bral ba dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gtsug gi nor bu rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug mtshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho dang*/ 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs sogs skyes bu dam pa du ma la dbang skur mang po dang*/ yi dam chos skyong so so'i bka' bsgo rjes gnang gtor dbang sogs bgrang bar mi dpyod pa gsan pa'i snyim pas bzhes shing*/ khyad par mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chen po/ dbang lung man ngag du ma'i 'byung gnas rin po che ma lus pa dkon mchog grags pa la yang bka' chos kyi 'brel ba mang du gsan zha ི nga*/ gzhan yang mkhas pa dang rnal 'byor ba ku sa li tshad dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la dbang dang byin rlabs ci rigs par gsan/

khyad par du rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas/ rta mgrin gyi gtor dbang zhig phul dus/ khro rgyal rta mgrin gyis zhal gzigs gsal ba'i mthar thug pa byung ngo*/ /de skabs shig bskal pa gzhal du med par tshogs gnyis rgya cher bsags pa yang smon lam rgya mtsho'i stobs kyis rgyal ba thams cad kyi bskyed pa'i yum du mngon par sprul pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i bdag nyid de nyid bsnyun gyis btab pa la sogs pa'i phyi rol mi 'tsham pa'i rkyen gang yang med par rang gnas mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing du bde bar bzhud do/ /de nas mi ring bar khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar dgongs shing*/ bla ma rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi bka' 'phebs pas kyang nye ba'i rkyen byas te dgung lo bdun pa chu pho stag gi lo la/ skyes bu dam pa du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhing khams/ dpal stag lung thang gi chos grwa chen por phebs shing dang po 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dang mjal/ slar bde bar gshegs pa rin po che bkra shis rnam rgyal dang seng gleng du mjal ba yin gsungs so/ /dgung lo brgyad pa la chos grwa de nyid du/ rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa nyid/ mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par skur bstan pa 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde'i drung du mkhan po zhus shing*/ zhu ba'i yul dge slong sdom brtson du ma dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ tshigs snga ma dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang*/ bar ma yang dag par blang ba gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par nod pa mdzad de/ mtshan ni kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gnang ste/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i mtshan de ka yin no zhes bka' bstsal lo/

/༈ phra zhing gos med 'od stong bdag po'i 'od/ /gangs dang sreg za la yang mngon 'bab ste/ /nyi ma'i zer la tsha grang dbye ba med/ /de bzhin 'dir yang bdag gis legs par 'khums/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sprul pas 'gro ba'i don/ /nyi 'od bzhin du kun la khyab spyod pa/ /'di la khyim nas rab tu 'byung ba zhes/ /bzang ngan dbye ba ci zhig blo ldan rnams/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin lhun 'grub tu/ /mtha' yas skye bo'i nyer 'tshor spyod pa la/ /ngur smrig tshal bus g.yogs pas ci zhig 'phags/ /lha rdzas 'bum phrag brgya yis nyes pa ci/ / baiḍūr 'od 'phrog ka shi'i gos mchog gis g.yogs rin chen za ma tog tu stsol/ /shing drung rnams ni bzhi mdo rgyu'o de 'dir cir mi rung gang rin chen brgyan/ /reg 'jam 'ja' 'od mdangs bkra'i g.yogs mas legs g.yogs srid gsum rin chen gcig pu 'di/ /nor bu gos mchog gzhan gyis spras pa mngon par btang nas ngur smrig tshul la brten 'di mtshar/ /gang gang bzang por gyur ba de dag ni/ /shin tu sbas shing mchog tu brgyan 'di la/ /'gro kun la son yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /rgyan byed gzhan med phyir na rgyan spangs bzhin/ /blo ldan yin yang 'dod la sred pas 'khyams/ /de dag rnams la gdams ngag mdzad pa'i phyir/ /srid gsum phun tshogs sku la yongs bzung nas/ /bung ba'i mdangs can gtsug phud bcad ces grags/ /ku mud 'dzum zhal kun dga'i zla snang can/ /bkra shis dge mtshan bdud rtsi'i zer 'phro bas/ /dpag yas 'gro kun chos kyi mgron du gnyer/ /'di yang khyed kyis thabs mkhas 'ba' zhig lags/ /de ltar na khyab bdag 'di ni ye shes kyi rang bzhin gcig pu'i phyir/ khyim na gnas pa rnams dang mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i bye brag med mod kyi/ 'di ltar ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bstan pa 'di yang dang po'i lus can rnams 'dod yon la brkam pa'i byang chub thob dka' bar gzigs nas/

nyes dmigs can gyi khyim spongs la thar pa'i grong khyer du 'jug par byos shig /ces gdams ngag mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges par 'byung ba'i tshul bstan pa las brtsam ste ci rigs par bsnyad pa'i sde tshan gnyis pa'o// //de nas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sprul pa'i sku chen po mkhyen pa dang brtse ba dang*/ nus mthu gzhal du med pa/ rin po che ngag dbang rnam rgyal bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yun ring du bsten par mdzad pa dang*/ lho pa slob dpon du grags pa gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i bzlas pa dung phyur lhag cig mdzad pas/ lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis rlabs pa'i rtags mtshan thams cad mngon du gyur pa nus mthu'i mnga' bdag de nyid las bslabs par bya ba'i gnas che phra thams cad dka' ba med pa'i thugs su chud par mdzad cing*/ sku na tshod shin tu phra ba de skabs kyang thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba 'jigs med grags pa'i bka' srol gyi rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du ma la phyag len mtha' rgyas su sbyong bar mdzad pas/ phyi nang gi de nyid bcu'i mnga' bdag tu gyur zha ི nga*/ zhabs 'bring ba 'ga' zhig dang lhan cig tu dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson par gnang bas/ snga gong cung zad ljags mi bde ba'i rnam pa'ang de nyid kyis rang grol zhing*/ gzhan ngor tshul bstan par snang yang lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs kyis mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas pa yin zhes zhal snga nas dngos su thob bo/ /lan gcig bcom ldan 'das dpal he badz+ra lha dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi sgrub mchod ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa zhig gnang skabs/ spyir byang phyogs sa khang bsil zhing*/ sgos su'ang de dus dgun grangs sgang rang yin snang bas chu rnams 'bab 'phro la rno ba'i dngos po 'dzin skabs yin na'ang*/

bum pa la dkris sogs gang yang med par yang bum chu ma 'khyag pa tsam du ma zad/ nyi ma gcig gnyis la bum nang nas ljang bu ring po thon pa 'byung zhing*/ de nyid lo grangs mang po'i bar du mos rten du bzung nas yod par snang ngo*/ /des na chung ngu nas sngags kyi nus pa rnyed pa'i tshul yang rgya cher bstan/ de nas rim pas snga phyi lan mang por 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo la/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul phyogs med du gsan par mdzad de/ sa bka' jo zhal shangs lugs bka' gdams sogs dbang lung man ngag gzhal du med pa gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad pas/ ris med pa'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag por gyur pa yin no/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi drung du/ 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' srol rma med pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam sprul dpal stag lung thang pa chen po nas nye bar brgyud pa/ stag lung bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags pa'i smin grol gyi lam mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par gsan pa dang rjes su 'brel bar kar 'brug 'bri gung ba sogs bka' brgyud pa bzhi'i gdams pa mtha' dag gsan zha

ི nga thugs su chud par mdzad nas/ khyad par brgyud pa'i bka' srol 'di ni rtogs pa don gyi brgyud par bzhed pa yin la/ khyad par rje btsun dam pa 'dis ni chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs gdod ma mngon sum du gzigs pa y-in zhing*/ gnas skabs gdul bya gzhan ngo dang bstun nas de skabs bla ma'i zhabs drung dang*/ dben gnas rnams su nyams len sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad de/ des na da lta nyams len zla ba gcig tsam ma byas par/ byin rlabs don gyis 'phos pa yin no zhes stong skad kyi rbad khams 'thag pa'i rdzun po che/ longs spyod dang mnga' thang la mngon par zhen pa/ g.yo sgyu gdul bya chen po 'grub pa'i rgyab bsten du zhen pa gting nas log pa la zang zing longs spyod char ltar 'bab pa yin no/ / zhes pa'i lung tshig 'dren par byed pa 'di dag ni/ rje btsun mi la dang*/ rje dwags po rin po che la sogs pa mnyam bzhag la rtsol ba dang*/ 'du 'dzi spangs pa rnams/ dbang po rtul zhing zhen pa ma log pa yin la/ kho bo cag ni dbang po rno zhing zhen pa gting nas log pa yin pas rtsol ba med pa'i lhun 'grub tu bsgom skye shing*/ 'du ba 'di tsam 'byung ba yin no zhes don gyis smra bar snang ngo*/ / ༈ ma lus srid pa'i snang ba 'di/ /'od gsal chen por ro gcig gyur/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba la/ /bsgom dang ma bsgom mnyam nyid gyur/ /snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di/ /rlung sems rten 'brel ma 'gags rtsal/ /rang bzhin byar med brjod du med/ /me long gzugs brnyan lta bur gzigs/ /nang du rang rig 'dzin pa'i sems/ /bde gsal snang ba rgyun chad med/ /snang bzhin byar med dbyings su 'dres/ /phyi nang ro gcig phyag rgya che/ / gdod ma rang bzhin dag pa ste/ /thog med dus nas mkhyen lags kyang*/ / 'dir yang 'bad rtsol du ma yis/ /mngon du gyur ba'i tshul yang bstan/

/yang skabs shig /mchod khang rtse nyid du gdan phab nas nag po chen po tsa tur bhu dza'i phyi nang gsang ba'i 'khrid kyi rim pa rnams bla ma mchog las nyams 'khrid du gsan pa'i tshe/ ji skad du bshad pa bzhin gyi rtags mtshan thams cad mngon du gyur/ khyad par las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi sprul pa mngon gsum du zhal gzigs shing*/ gzigs snang de yang shin tu brtan zhing yun ring du gnas pa zhig byung*/ de yang zhal mang po can khro zhal rnams gsal bar mngon du ston zhing*/ bya rog gi gdong dar nag gis g.yogs pa'i rnam pa can du 'dug gsung ngo*/ /spyir ni chos dang ldan pa thams cad la chos skyong rnams kyis bu bzhin skyong bar mdzad pa yin na/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog 'di lta bu la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyad par rje 'dis gzhan ngor bsnyen sgrub kyang ches mthar son par mdzad pas 'phrin las thams cad ye shes kyi mgon po 'dis rtsol med du sgrub par mdzad pa ni bdag cag rnams kyis kyang mngon gsum du mthong ngo*/ /de yang sgrub yig rnams su 'byung ba bzhin rab la dngos su zhal bstan nas las byed pa dang*/ 'bring la mi nag po'i gzugs kyis las byed pa dang*/ tha ma la'ang sprul pa'i bya rog gi gzugs ston zha ི nga las byed par gsungs ba las/ bdag cag shin tu bskal pa dman pa rnams kyang snang ngor yang phyi ma 'di gnyis mngon sum du gyur pa ni zhabs 'bring du cung zad re 'khod pas kyang sgro btags med par rtogs par gyur pa zhig go /rje de nyid kyis gsan pa rgya mtsho lta bu ni gsan yig tu shes par bya'o/ /de nas dgung lo nyi shur son pa na/ rje bde bar gshegs pa rin po che bkra shis rnam rgyal nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad de/ ji skad bshad pa'i mngon 'gyur bcu'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po bsnyen par mdzad nas bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag por gyur pa yin no/

/ 'di skabs mtshan yang*/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs grub bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gsum pa gsol lo/ /sngon dus ngur smrig gi rgyan bzhes pa tsam nas bzung bslab pa'i gnas phra zhing phra ba la yang spyan gyis 'bras bu ltar dgongs pa'i gces spras su gnang ba yin na/ 'di phyin chad du ni lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu sku gsum thugs kyi ngang tshul zhi ba dang*/ dul ba dang*/ nges pa dang*/ legs par gdams pa'i tshul 'di gcig pus kyang*/ da lta'i chen por grags pa thams cad kyi yon tan ma lus pa zil gyis gnon pa 'di yin no/ /de nas rje rnam rgyal bkra shis de nyid dben pa la thugs lhag par gzhol ba'i ngang tshul gyis kun spangs kyi rnal 'byor mdzad par dgongs nas/ dam pa 'di nyid dpal 'jig rten gyi mgon po thang pa chen po'i gdan sa mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khrir rgyal tshab tu nye bar 'khod de/ sngar rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyi dus su mchog tu bca' khrims dam par yod pa rim pa bzhin du gdan sar byon pa rnams kyis kyang spyir bca' khrims thams cad yar ldan du mdzad pa lags kyang*/ dus kyi dbang gis cha shas nyams par gyur pa dag sor chud par mdzad de/ chos rje'i rnam thar bcu gsum tshogs kyi bca' ba bcu gsum/ gling gi 'dul khrims bcu gsum rnams rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyis skabs nyid spar btab pa bzhin mdzad cing*/ de yang shing mo bya lo zla ba dang po la gdan sar phebs pa yin zhing*/ khri thog tu phebs nas mnga' dbul bgyid pa'i skabs/ me tog gi char pa babs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma/ khyad par nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms pa dang*/ phu chu'i 'khyag pa thams cad zhu nas brag chur 'dre ba sogs byung ste/ dpal stag lung pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i rten 'byung ya mtshan can rmad du byung ba'o/

/der stag lung lha sde'i mnga' zhabs bod 'brog sde dang bcas pa/ snga srol gyi phyag rgyun bzang po yod pa ltar/ thams cad phyag tu gnang ste/ mdor na stag lung pa'i lugs gnyis kyi mnga' bdag tu dbang bskur ro/ /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams tshad med na/ /ji snyed mtha' yas mgon gyi rgyal khyod la/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'byor pa kun bcas te/ /sras kyi gtso bo gcig pu khyod dbang bskur/ /'gro ba kuna~X la srid zhi'i dga~X' ston 'gyed/ /bkra~X shi~Xs rgyala~X mtsha~Xn phyogs brgyar bsgreng bzhin du/ /mtha' dag skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho 'dren pa khyod/ /rab brtan seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'khod/ /de tshe phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa sras bcas rnams/ /kuna~X nas rab dga~X'i thugs kyi lha lam la/ /bkra~X shisa~X lan brgyar brjod cing me tog char/ /ci yang phab pas phyogs kuna~X nye bar 'gog /bstan 'dzin kun gyi dbus nas dga~X' ba'i tog /bkra~X shi~Xs dge mtshan brgya yi mngon 'bar ba'i/ / mtshungs med bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu la/ yang yang bsam bzhin snying nas dad pa skyes/ /zhes pa 'di ni rgyal tshab tu mngon par dbang bskur ba las brtsam ste bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te gsum pa'o// //de la kho bo cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di ni/ dpal stag lung gi gdan sa'i rabs ji snyed byon pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang*/ lugs gnyis char gyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa la/ rje rin po che 'di ni 'gran zla dang bral ba yin no/ /de nas mi ring ba'i skabs shig na karma pa'i bu chen/ kar lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang na mchog tu mkhas par bkur ba/ chos rje dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bar grags pas kyang*/ rje rnam rgyal bkra shis la gus pa'i spyi bos zhabs kyi pad+mo la nyer bar mchod par byas shing*/ khong grags che bas stag lung dge 'dun rnams kyis chos ci rigs par gsan snang*/ phyir phebs kar rje 'dis rnyed bkur la spyan 'dren par mdzad 'dug pas/

bzhugs gral grol nas thugs kar rje 'di nyid la gus pas thal mo sbyor bzhin pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje bskul bzhin du sku tshe brtan pa dang 'phrin las rgyas par gsol ba btab nas thegs song zhes zer/ de ltar na rgyal po rnams kyis lhag par bkur ba'i stobs kyi che thabs la shin du brtson pa'i dregs ldan chen po mchog tu grags pa re re las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten shas cher la yang 'dud pa dang bral ba dag kyang 'di ltar thugs rje'i zil gyis cher mnan nas gus pas 'dud na gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas gtsug lag khang gi gser tog gañdz-i+-i+ir ra chen mo khru bzhi bcu'i tshad tsam gyi gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba 'di nyid bzhengs par bzhed pa la/ bal po'i yul nas bzo bo tshan che ba sku drung du lhags shing*/ bzo phud la 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo'i sku brnyan dngul sku rkang gang ma zhig grub rjes/ gser tog chen mo nyid bzhengs par mdzad cing*/ 'di yi byug gser la gser 'dul zho dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa lnga song zhing*/ gzungs gzhugs yang gdung sha ri raṃ yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring srel dang*/ gzungs sngags 'khor lo la sogs pas nye bar gtams pa/ mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes mthong ba brgyud pa ma nyams pa ltar gnang zhing*/ rje rnam rgyal bkra shis kyis gzungs gzhug rnams kyang phyag ltar bar mdzad cing*/ rab tu gnas pa'ang shin du rgyas pa dga' ston blo las 'das pa dang*/ bzo ris pa rnams la bza' btung dang yon gyi gnang sbyin dpe bral blo 'das kyis mgu ba bskyed par mdzad/ 'di'i snga phyi thams cad du kun spangs rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis nyid kyis bstan pa spyi dang bye brag thams cad dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ rje 'di'i bzhed don thams cad 'grub pa'i smon lam yang yang mdzad pas/ phyis rten bzhengs sogs rlabs po che'i mdzad pa thams cad gegs med du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel thams cad legs par 'grigs pa yin no zhes grags so/

/de nas rim gyis dus gzhan dang gzhan du gtsug lag khang chen mo'i bad dkar po'i khyon rnams dang*/ lha khang mthil gyi logs rnams su bris sku mthong ba don ldan gyi sku'i bkod pa gzab bris su mdzad pa dang*/ bskal bzang gi de bzhin gshegs pa stong gi sku brnyan gyi rgyud ris dang*/ thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku brnyan sogs gtsug lag khang chen mo rgya khyon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i logs bris shas che ba yang grub par mdzad/ bris thang yang mgon khang rnying mar bzhugs pa'i mgon thang chen mo dang*/ rnam sras kyi gos thang chen mo/ bde mchog /dgyes rdor/ 'jigs byed/ las mgon gnyis dang bcas pa/ bzo ris mkhas pa'i gzab bris su mdzad pa dpe bral de rnams kyang legs par grub cing*/ rab gnas kyi bar gyi mtha' rgyas kyang brtsal/ de nas ring por mi thogs par/ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po kun spangs rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis de nyid chos kyis dbyings su zhi bar gzims pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ zab yang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po gzhal du med pa'i bkod pa dang*/ sku gdung rin po che de nyid sa gzhi byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba rnams la thar pa'i sa bon mchog bskrun pa'i slad du/ dngul gyis gdung khang bya bar bzhed de/ gser rkyang zho nyis brgya lhag pa sogs rgyu tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rin po che'i phung po chen po'i 'di nyid dang*/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sku brnyan bar chad kun sel du grags pa 'di nyid la dngul srang stong brgal ba dang*/ gdan dang rgyan bkod la gser zho bzhi bcu'i skud gser btang ba dang*/ nang bzhugs su byin rlabs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan byin rlabs can dang*/ gser dngul las grub pa'i gzungs sngags rnams rgyud sde rin po che nas ji skad gsungs pa ltar slob dpon mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes ltar gzungs bzhugs kyi gtams par mdzad cing dngul gdung rin po che 'di nyid bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam rten sogs byin rlabs rten blo las 'das pas gang ba yin na'ang*/

yi ge mang bas 'dir ma brjod/ de dag gi rab gnas la/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo spyan 'dren par mdzad de/ dngul gdung gi gzungs bzhugs kyang rje btsun ma chog pa cung zad kyang ma byung*/ lam gyi dka' ba thams cad khyad du bsad nas chos lung byang rtser phebs pa'i tshe/ sgrub gnas dam pa der bzhugs pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis phebs bsu'i bkod pa mdzad pa na/ nam mkha' la me tog gi char sngon chad sus kyang mig lam du ma phebs pa dag kyang byung zhing*/ khyad par me tog bzung du rung ba yang du ma byung ngo*/ / der dkar me rgyun sbar dang*/ mchod rdzas mchod pa'i thebs sogs blos gzhal bar dka' ba sogs 'bul bar gnang zhing*/ bstan 'gro'i don du smon lam rgya chen po gnang bzhin du zla gcig skor bzhugs ring rnyed bkur rnams ni dpon drung tshe dbang 'phan dar bas dang bzhes su mdzad/ g.yas ru byang nas chos rgyal kun dga' rin chen yang mjal bar phebs shing gus pas zhabs la gtugs/ de nas slar yang rim gyis gzhung lam brgyud nas phebs te gang dang gang du phebs pa der/ bla ma slob dpon skya ser che phra thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs shing*/ chos dang zang zing gi 'byor bas tshim par mdzad de/ rang gnas thang pa chen po'i gdan sa nyid du phebs nas dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su bsti bar mdzad do/ /de nas 'brug lo'i nang du zhwa dmar nag gnyis 'dus kyi sgar pa 'bri gung nas 'phan yul brgyud/ dpal stag lung thang gi gdan sa mjal bar phebs shing*/ zhag bdun tsam bzhugs/ rnyed bkur dang 'bul ba'i gnang skyes rgya cher gnang zhing*/ gling gi dge 'dun byings kyis kyang rnyed bkur 'bul ba dpe bral mdzad/ zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa dkon mchog yan lag la bka' 'brel tsam gsan/ de'i phyir lor rje drung zhwa dmar bas/ rje 'di nyid spyan 'dren gnang bas yangs can du phebs pa'i tshe/ sgar gyi grwa tshang so so'i dge 'dun rnams kyis ser 'phreng dang*/

phyag mdzod sku mched sogs drung 'khor rnams kyi chibs hrag gis phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya cher mdzad/ sgar chen gyis lo gsar smon lam dang bcas pa dus 'grigs pas/ rnyed bkur bsam las 'das pa byung*/ gan rdo la'i mchod bshams su grags pa rnams kyang zhib rgyas su gzigs pa phul/ skabs 'dir rje zhwa dmar ba la rka kaṃ tshang gi chos bka' yod pa thams cad gsan/ rje 'di nyid la tshur rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin po che ma nu hu'i zhal bu sogs khyad nor gyi 'bul ba rngams su brgal ba byung bla ma g.yung sogs bu chen rnams dang phyag mdzod sku mched/ sde pa nas rin pa sogs sgar gyi drag zhan ma lus pa yang mchog tu gus pa thob ste/ chos 'brel ma thob pa gcig kyang med/ de nas pho 'do'i sde pa don bzang ba gshegs par nye ba'i bang chen gyis bskul te/ stag lung du phebs/ mi ring bar 'khon rigs dam pa grub pa'i dbang phyug bdag chen rin po che kun dga' bsam 'grub dpon slob rnams stag lung du phebs/ yang dgon du spyan 'dren zhu bar mdzad/ rdo rje phur pa la sogs pa zab chos mang du gsan/ rnyed bkur 'bul ba dpe bral gnang zhing bdag chen rin po ches kyang gser dmar las grub pa'i dril bu bzo khyad ches 'phags pa phyag tu 'bul bar snang*/ sku rim gtor bzlog phyag len mtha' rgyas kyang gzigs yul du phebs/ yang lan cig byang rigs la phebs dus/ gnyan chen thang lhas mchod pa dang 'dud pa'i gzigs snang cher byung bar snang bas/ spyi mthun mthong snang la sgra dang 'ja' 'od dang*/ me tog gi char babs pa sogs dang*/ khyad par 'ja' tshon la bkra shis rtags brgyad shin tu gsal bar byung*/ de nas skye rabs brgya rtsa'i gzab bris thang ka bzhi bcu tsam la grub pa zhig bzhengs par gnang zhing*/ rab gnas yon rdzogs sogs kyis bar thams cad mtha' rgyas su 'grub par mdzad/ de nas lcags pho rta'i lo la/ bal yul bzo rigs mkhas pa'i mthar phyin pa/

dpon mo che dzā ti pā la sogs sku gzhogs su 'byor ba la/ rten thog mar bzo phud du bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku rgyab mtho gang ba zhig bzhengs par mdzad/ slar thub chen mthong ba don ldan nyid bzo dbu 'dzug par mdzad de/ ring por mi thog par gegs med du mthar phyin 'di ni sku tshad ches che drags pas mchod khang du ma shong bar zhal ras lha khang gsar du bzhengs dgos byung zhing*/ 'di'i nang bzhugs su thub pa chen po'i ring srel rnam bzhi sogs byin rlabs brjod las 'das pa bzhugs/ rten bsgrigs gnang bas rgya mtho bzhi bcu zhe lnga byung zhing*/ rab gnas dga' ston yon rdzongs kyi bar du thams cad mtha' dag tshang bar gnang ngo*/ /'di dag gi skabs shig dpal ldan a ti sha'i bshad sgrub kyi bka' srol skyong ba la 'gran zla dang bral ba/ dpal ldan sa skya ba'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi snying po/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi rnam 'phrul du grags pa/ lo pa spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos grags pa ched kyis spyan 'dren pa mdzad de/ bka' gdams kyi chos skor mtha' yas pa gsan zhing thugs su chud mdzad cing*/ ji skad bshad pa'i bla ma dam pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mnga' ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa mchog de la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gus pa dang*/ rnyed bkur dang*/ yon 'bul dang*/ phu dud du bya bar mdzad cing*/ spyan snga rin po che 'di de dus dgung lo brgyar nye bar bzhes pa'i skabs yin la/ de ltar sku tshe'i dpal brnyes pa'i rten 'brel du dgongs nas phyir phebs dus tshe dbang brgya rtsa zhig kyang gsan/ de nyid kyis rten 'brel las bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba yang 'debs so/ /de nas bar skabs su chos kyi bar du gcod pa cung zad la brten pa'i zhal ngo nas kyang rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'dir cung zad thugs 'dzer bag can du mdzad pa 'byung zhing*/ de ka'i rgyab zhing 'bri khung nas mdzad pas lo shas shin tu thugs sun par byung la 'on kyang rje 'di nyid kyi dam pa'i chos kyi mdzad pa rlabs po che la ni bar du gcod pa ma nus te/

lha chen bzhengs pa'i sgang nyid la dus 'khrug cher byung 'dug cing*/ nyin gcig gi bzo tsam yang ma chags par rab gnas zhal gro'i bar tu mthar phyin pa/ rten 'brel gyi sgo ma lus pa rang 'grig ste/ ha hor gyi rgyal khams kyi las sgo bzang po 'di lta bu longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po legs par brdol ba yin no/ /kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang bo'i thugs dam rten gyi gtso bo rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje rgya gar ma las kyang bzo khyad bla lhag tsam du mngon pa de nyid/ gtsug lag khang mes bzhes dus/ sku ngo bo la skyon ma byung yang*/ nang zungs rnams zhugs bzhes 'dug pa/ slar yang byin rlabs kyi rten dang nor khyad 'phags mang pos 'gengs par gnang nas legs par gsos/ gnas bcu lha khang gi logs bris dang sku 'bum gyi zh-ig gsos dang*/ mchod snying gi zhig gsos/ bstan srung dge bsnyen chen po'i rten khang logs bris sogs kyang rim pas gnang ngo*/ /'dir smras pa/ gang gi mdzad pa dpag yas gzhal du med/ /'di la blo ldan gyis kyang dpyad du med/ /'khor ba'i khams la 'phel med 'grib pa med/ khyed kyi 'phrin las 'di la chad pa med/ /mkhas kuna~X mngon par dga~X' ba'i legs bshad dang*/ /skye bo mtha' dag bkra~X shisa~X dge legs can/ /chos kyi rgyala~X mtsha~Xn srid mthar bsgreng la mkhas/ /'gro ba'i dpa~Xl gyur mdzad pa bza~Xng po~X can/ khyed ltar srid 'dir gzhan ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gnas mgon po khyod/ /bskal brgya'i bar du bzhugs gsol zhes/ /bdag ni rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan pa'i mdzad pa rlabs po che las brtsams te/ cung zad bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te bzhi pa'o// //dam pa 'di snga phyi lan mang por hor stod smad kyi mnga' zhabs byang rigs kyi sa'i khyon thams cad du phyag phebs cing*/ dbyar dus gnam chu shin du che ba la ko gru sogs yul gyis gshes nas gtan med kyang phyag nas 'thor ba tsam mam/

thugs dam gtor ma re tsam gnang ba kho nas 'phral du chu bri nas/ byis pa chung ngus kyang bde blag tu brgal bar nus pa tsam du 'gro zhing*/ dpon slob rnams phebs grub ma thag tu sngar lugs bzhin du chu brub nas 'gro ba sha stag byung bas/ mtha' yas pa'i skye bo thams cad shas cher rdzu 'phrul la yid rton pa'i phyir/ mchog tu gus pa'i thal mo lan brgyar sbyor bar byed do/ /

gzhan yang ji tsam pa'i skye bo'i tshogs che ba 'di tsam sku drung du rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba la/ 'thab rtsod kyi rnam pa cung zad dam/ rim gyis btab pa'am/ gnag phyugs sogs srog chags ji snyed cig 'bul ba 'byung ba la yang*/ phyugs nad kyi rnam pas btab pa sogs ni grong 'khor ches rgan po rnams kyis kyang gtan mi dran/ ja gos dar go khrab rtsi bcud rta nor sogs de ring kho na dngos po'i 'bul ba mang snyam pa nyag gcig rtag par yod cing*/ skye bo tshogs chen rnams la bsnyen gnas sems bskyed yig drug gi sgom lung sogs yi dam dang chos skyong gi dbang dang rje gnang so so gang la gang 'dod 'tsham par stsol ba dang*/ zang zing gis skye dgu thams cad kyi bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad cing hor stod smad sogs 'thab rtsod 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar snang bas/ thugs snying rje chen pos byin rlabs kyi mthus/ rje 'di'i bka' stsal phebs pa la/ thams cad kyang zhi ba'i sems kyi nyan shes dang ldan par gyur zhing*/ sems can thams cad bde ba'i thabs la dgongs nas/ phyag rdzas rngam che ba kun yang so sor stsol bar mdzad do/ /phyogs lhung spangs pa'i gzi yig gis bcad de dam bzhag gnang ba la brten/ lo bcu gnyis tsam mam lo grangs ci rigs par dus khams shin du bde bar gyur ba zhi tshe yin te/ phyi rabs kyi chen po 'ga' zhig ltar gyis dus 'khrugs sdum pa ltar bcos te nor gyi bya dga' sogs kyis 'phral gnyis thad nas mi mgu ba med tsam la/ phugs su rang phyogs ches nga rgyal bar byed pa'i g.yo sgyus zhal lce gcod pa 'di lta bu dang*/ gzhan dag sdum pa'i zol gyis gnyis bar nas bdag nyid kyi dbang thang longs spyod kho na yid la brnags pas sgrub rtsol byed cing*/ gzhan thes med du byas nas rang gis thob brtsi ba sogs skyes bu dam pa yin no zhes rlung ltar grags pa rnams la yang dam pa ma yin pa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bur bying ba'i skyon dag mthong ba'i tshe/

bdag nyid kyi don thams cad khyad du bsad de gzhan bde 'ba' zhig bsgrub par dgongs pa khyod la zol med snying thag pa nas dad pa'i yid kyis 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid gdung rigs kyi mchog 'di lta bur sku'i skye ba brnyes shing*/ lugs gnyis kyis mngon par mtho ba 'di tsam gyis mngon par brgyan pa dang*/ mkhas btsun bzang bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan 'phrin las blo las 'das pa 'di tsam du bzhugs kyang thugs khengs pa'i dri ma thams cad yongs su bral ba dang*/ zhabs drung du mi lo bzhi bcu tsam nye bar bsten pa dag gis kyang rang bstod bdag nyid sgrogs pa'i tshig gcig kyang gsungs pa ma tshor bar snang zhing*/ mu to ba tshun chad la yang zhe sa dang bcas pa'i tshig gis bsti stangs mdzad pa las brnyas pa'i dri ma tsam yang mi mdzad cing*/ dge ba'i las bgyi ba cung zad dang ldan pa'i skye bo gzhan thams cad kyis 'phya zhing smod par byed pa'i gnas kun la yang*/ bdag nyid las ches lhag par bsngags par mdzad cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyi cha shas yig 'bru tsam mam/ mchod rten zhig ro tshun chad dang dge 'dun gyi cha shas ngur smrig gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa kun la yang mchog tu gus pa chen pos thal mo sbyar ba sogs mthong te/ skyes bu dam pa las kyang ches dam pa'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyod ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /yon tan chu bo stong gis khengs mi mnga'/ /blo chung snod ngan sa yi bum pa dag /rnyed bkur chu thigs gcig gis khengs shing 'jig /'gro las rgyal slad gzhan 'phrul bdag po yis/ /sgyu thabs sgyu can rnams la dbang phyug dang*/ /'byor ba'i rkyen byas chos bzhin spyod pa rnams/ /chad pa sbyin 'dis bdud rtsis lam chen bkum/ / srid pa'i chu mtshor sgyu can chu skyar 'ga'/ /bshes gnyen yid 'ongs sa dkar ltar bsdus nas/

/'bum phrag skye bo'i nya rnams bslu brid kyis/ /ngan 'gro'i mya ngam thang la za bar mthong*/ /bdag don tsher ma'i khur po bor gyur nas/ / gzhan don shing rtar 'jug pa'i kha lo ba/ /gya gyu spangs te drang po'i lam ston mkhan/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gcig khyod la bdag yid gus/ /de nas bya lo'i nang du 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa'i bstan pa'i srog shing chen po rin po che bstan 'dzin grags pa nyid kyang dpal stag lung thang gi chos grwa chen por gzigs dgos shing spyan 'dren gyis kyang mtshams sbyar nas phebs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de la 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po nyid kyi rang lugs las 'ong ba'i/ phyag bzhes rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mang por dbang bskur gsan zhing*/ khrid tshul mtha' yas 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i nye lam chen po sbas don kun gsal sogs chos tshul mang du gsan/ rnyed bkur dang 'bul ba'i dngos po gya nom pa'i tshogs kyis mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid slob mar bcas pa ches dgyes pa chen por bskyed nas thegs/ de skabs shig sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams thog rer bzhugs shing*/ bar skabs shig mi tshan bcu gsum gyis nor rdzong byas pa drangs bzhi rdzong zhes pa/ phyis bdag med du lus pa zhig byung 'dug pa de/ stag lung gi sa gnad shin tu che bar dgongs nas/ thog mar gzim khang dang bcas pa mthar thon gnang stai/ chos rdzong rnam rgyal rab brtan du ming 'dogs snang*/ 'di ni 'jig rten dngos kyi sa gnad tsam ma yin pa/ sa chu nam mkha' gsum shais rab e gru gsum gyi rnam pa can dang*/ rdzong ri nyid waṃ yig gi tshul du gnas pa dang*/ gzhan yang phyi nang gi rten 'brel sa dpyad ming 'dogs sogs dpal stag lung thang gi bstan pa rin po che la lhag par gal che ba zhig /ye shes kyi gzigs pa sgrib med kyis gzigs nas gnang 'dug pas/ ring por mi thog par mngon du gyur pa 'di yin/

yang skabs shig thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin pa/ bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i sprul pa'i sku 'chi med 'od zer yang rje nyid mjal du phebs/ zhabs kyi pad+mo la nye bar gtugs nas kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos phyag len gyi dkyil 'khor mang po'i dbang bskur dang*/ thugs dam zab chos mang du gsan te/ mchog tu thabs gus pa chen pos rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad do/ /de nas shing pho khyi lo la/ bal po'i lha bzo bud+dha pa la sogs bzo tshan lnga pa zhig zhabs drung du 'byor bas nye ba'i rkyen byas te/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po mi tshad ma dang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug /ha shangs dharma ta la rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan thams cad kyang sku tshad mda' gang tsam pa bzo khyad phul du byung ba legs par grub cing*/ skud gser la gser zho brgya phrag lnga lhag gcig song snang ba/ rgyu'i khyad par gzhan rnams des dpag par nus so/ /'di la gzungs bzhugs kyang thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel shin du tshogs che ba dang*/ stag lung bka' brgyud nyid kyi bla ma gong ma rnams gtso bor gyur ba'i byin rlabs kyi rten mang po dang*/ gser dngul gyi gzungs yig bsgrang bar mi dpyod pa dang bcas pa phyag len dag pas gzungs bzhugs gnang*/ 'di'i gtso bo bzhengs pa'i zhal lta gnang nas/ hor stod pa'i spyan 'dren pa bzhin phebs nas bzhugs sgar shel rje'i rgyud du gnang skabs/ phyag nas gnang ba stag lung nyid du nyin par skye bo mang po'i mthun snang du grub par gtso bo'i sku gzugs kyi sku 'phang du nam mkha' nas me tog mang du phebs pa brdzun med yid ches 'drongs par byung snang zhing*/ de yang gzhan dag ltar mtshan mo'i dus dang lkog tu mi nas thogs pa dag sbed pa la sogs pa'i g.yo thabs dang*/ skal ldan 'ga' re'i mthong snang la byung skad pa dang*/

ston rgyu med bzhin du dpon dbang gi phyug dag gis 'byung ngo zhes dbang che'i tshig gis rjes su 'brang ba tsam ma yin par mngon sum du skye bo thams cad kyis spyi mthun du mthong ba yin no/ / 'di yang drang por brjod pa tsam yin gyi mi ma yin grub par dang bon po sogs la'ang thun mong gi yon tan ston rgyu yod de 'di tsam gyi rtags la 'dren pa mchog ga la re/ thugs dul ba dang btsun pa dang mkhas pa dang lhag pa'i thugs stong nyid snying rje snying po can mnga' ba sogs thun mong ma yin pa mchog gi yon tan gzhal du med pa mnga' ba 'di nyid skyes bu dam pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin no/ /de dag dang stabs gcig tu/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi sku dgos 'dod kun 'byung gser zho lnga bcu'i byugs gser can phul du phyung ba'i nang bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di nyid kyang bzhengs par mdzad/ rab gnas kyang rje nyid rigs pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang bcas pas gnang*/ rab gnas legs shing shin tu bkra shis pas 'phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad las legs par grol ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs rigs byed pa rnams la yon rdzong bcad thang las brgal ba'i dpe bral blo 'das dges pa chen po dang bcas te gnang bas/ khong rnams kyang gzhan du lo bdun las kyang 'dir ha lam rnyed pa bzang ba byung zhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mgu ba thob/ de nas me pho byi ba'i lo la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gan shog la rin po che'i khu bas bri bar gnang ba/ lo de nyid la glegs bam brgyad cu rtsa drug la na bza' rten khebs bzang bsgrigs tog dkar zhal khebs sum brtsegs ma/ bzang gos kyi glegs thag dang glegs shing sogs rnam pa thams cad nas dpe dang bral ba legs par grub cing*/ bzo ris pa nyis brgya bud tsam kun la yang nam mkha' mdzod las yid bzhin gyi char phab pas mchog tu tshim pa thob bo/ /'di skabs su mda' dar 'bul dbon grags pa 'od zer ba dpon g.yog sogs yul phyogs la 'bul sdud du gnang ba rgyal po chen po a dan khan gyis gus pas btud de/

rgyal po'i gser yig dang bcas lhan cig tu gdan sa chen po stag lung du 'byor/ gser dngul gos dar ja ras rta dre'u rnga mong sogs kyis 'bul ba'i sa steng khyab par phul zhing*/ de skabs 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo'i sku dbon po/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku jo nang kun mkhyen chen po'i seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'khod pa/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang po zhes sku btsun zhing grub pa dang byin rlabs kyis nye bar brgyan pa/ bdag nyid chen po de yang mjal bar phebs te/ dpon slob thugs nang gtsang ba'i shin tu dgyes pa chen por gyur/ zab chos rmad du byung ba mang bo phan tshun du gsan res gnang*/ lo 'di nyid kyi nang du dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse 'phrin las kyi ngo bo rgyal dbang sprul pa'i sku stag lung rin po che 'dis kyang gdan sa chen por phebs pa'i thog ma yin zhing*/ phyi lo dbyar sos nor rnams kyi dus 'khrug gi sdum la byang rgyab tu phebs/ legs par sdum pa'i skabs shig ma rung ba'i sems can 'ga' zhig gis mi bzad pa'i las mngon par sgrub pa ni 'di ltar te/ nyin gcig bzhugs sgar na 'khor tshogs mang po'i zhabs 'bring dang bcas nas bzhugs skabs shig bka' stsal nas/ mi nga la ni mngon sum thabs su phyag tu yi ge rgya can zhig 'bul ba byung bas/ the'u tshe'i kha ris la rje btsun mi la'i sku zhig snang*/ yi ge'i nang na'ang zhag bdun nas mi 'di bzhin byung*/ mi 'di lta bu tha na gos lham kyang 'di bzhin du 'ong zhes sogs don 'di bzhin 'dug ces gdug sems can gyi mi de dang de yi ming mi gsal tsam ma gtogs ma sbas lhug par bka' stsal gnang*/ de ji ltar bka' stsal gnang ba bzhin zhag bdun gyi mtshams nas gsol zas ngan pas sku bsnyel zhing*/ dbon pad+mas mi de rnams kyis ming gang yin bka' stsal gnang dgos zhes nan cher zhus 'dug na'ang*/

de kun la gnod pa byung bar dgongs nas ye bka' stsal ma gnang*/ sku khams shin tu dub pas na re zhig gdan sar phebs pa gnang ma thub par/ dbyar ngos de sa phyogs de nyid rang du bzhugs shing*/ sman pa mkhas pa rnams kyi gso dpyad rnams rim par phul/ de dus zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag yangs pa can du bzhugs skabs yin zhing*/ rin chen ril bu khyad par can sogs gsol sman khyad par can/ phal che ba'ang zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa'i phyag nas 'bul ba gnang*/ ston gyi dus nas sku khams rim gyis bde nas gdan sa nyid du phyag phebs so/ /da ltar gyi bar du yang rje nyid zhal zas ngan pa gsol bas gdug pa can de kun la ched du dmigs nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che bsgom par mdzad cing*/ 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du phan bde'i rgyu 'gyur ba smon lam yang dag par thugs thag pa nas gnang ba ni bdag cag gis kyang yang yang mthong ste/ sngon dus rje 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo grub pa la yang 'di bzhin 'byung ba/ 'gro ba'i mgon po'i gsung las/ 'di ngan song du mi gtong ba'i gnyer kha kho bo la yod pa lags/ zhes gsungs pa yang rnam thar 'di las gzhan du med de/ des na gang dag gnod pa cung zad byed pa'i dgra la yang yul 'bud pa dang*/ chad pa gcod pa dang*/ yon bdag dang*/ rgyal po gzhan dang gzhan nas/ sdug las ci thon byed bzhin du/ phyi mar sems can rnams 'khor ba las 'dren pa'i smon lam byed skad de/ pha ma'i mgo gcod bzhin du/ ri dwags chus khyer ba la snying rje zhes zer ba dang 'dra'o/ / dais na rang gi longs spyod mnga' thang la cung zad gnod par mthong na/ yon bdag dang rgyal po du ma bskul nas gtsug lag khang du ma mes sregs pa dang*/ khyim pa dang rab byung brgya stong g.yul du gsod pa sogs mthong ste/ de dag ni bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu lta ga la zhig /bdud sdig can dge slong ga gzugs zhes bya ba yang 'di las gzhan du med cing*/

de lta na sku la bsdo bar byed pa de lta bu mngon sum mkhyen bzhin du mi gsungs zhing*/ gzhan rnams las kyang ches lhag par thugs brtse ba'i yul du mdzad pa 'di lta bu sngon gyi dus su mang du byung mod kyi da ltar gyi dus su ni bdag cag gi 'dren pa 'di gcig pu'i mdzad pa'o/ / 'dir smras pa/ gzhan bde dge ba cung zad tsam la yang*/ /bdag don ma lus gtong ba rgyal sras lugs/ /'gro la snyoms par brtse ba nyid lags kyang*/ /gnod byed rnams la lhag par brtse 'di mtshar/ /'di na dam par khas 'che chen po 'ga'/ /nad dang bcas pa'i dge slong gzhan mchod nas/ /yun ring bdag la byams shing bkur ba yang*/ /brtse med sems kyis chad pas gcod pa mthong*/ /dpa' bo mi bsrun dge slong stag gi tshul/ /zas nor sgyu ma'i khrag la snoms pa ni/ /nyes pa ci la'ang dga' ma'i srog gcod ma/ /'di la gzhan dag bag yod cis mi 'ong*/ /'od gsal ngur smrig gdengs ka'i nor bu can/ /gdug rtsub yan lag khong du rnam par sbas/ /gya gyus 'jug cing snyan 'jam phud kyi sgras/ /'dri byed lag 'gro'i tshul can 'ga' med dam/ /'gro kun dag byed thugs rje'i 'od dkar can/ /bdag la brtse bral ri dwags kyis gnag pa/ /ngan spyod mtshan mo'i mun par 'khyams pa'i mgon/ /gdung sel bkra shis gcig pu 'di na shar/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad spyod khyad par can 'ba' zhig las brtsams te cung zad bsnyad pa'i sde tshan de lnga pa'o// //de nas 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag gi lo shar ba na stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ji gir gan gyi rgyal rgyud ma nyams pa/ swog po'i rgyal po rnams kyis spyan 'dren nan zhus byung ba'i tshe/ phebs par dgongs pa gtad cing gzhir bzhugs drag zhan kun dang*/ yon bdag sde rigs kun gyis kyang nan tan gyis bzhugs par zhus kyang*/ cis kyang phebs par thag chod gnang*/ de kha'i stabs kyis chos 'brel zhu ba dang*/

sku gzhogs su don gcod par 'ong ba'i rdzongs bkod gnang dgos sogs lugs gnyis kyis thugs brel shin du che ba'i ngang nas kyang mchog gi sprul sku rin po che la nye bar mkho ba'i bzhes kyi dbang bskur mang po dang*/ rjes gnang zab bsdus mtha' yas pa dang bka' rgyud gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum phal cher gyi bka'i glegs bam rnams kyi bka' gtad kyang gnang zhing*/ lha sar jo bo rin po cher mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa dang bcas smon lam gnang bar phebs skyi shod kyi zhal ngo rnams dang ser 'bras dge gsum gyi bla ma che phra thams cad rje 'di nyid mjal bar phebs shing gus pas btud/ phal cher gyis bka' chos kyi 'brel ba re yang zhus/ skyi shod zhal ngo rnam pas sgo la'i bar du phebs skyel la phebs shing*/ myur du phebs par zhal gyis bzhes/ slar yang gdan sa nyid du phebs te cung zad gdan chags/ rje drung karma pa dbang phyug rdo rjes kyang*/ bka' rgyud chu bo'i 'byung khungs dge legs dag byed chu bo'i rgyun/ /sa gsum khyab par mdzad mkhas las chen bzhi dang grub chen brgyad/ /kun gyi mnga' bdag dpal ldan stag lung thang pa chen po yis/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la bzhugs bzhin bkra shis dge legs can/ /zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ de tshe sku gsung thugs 'khor dang*/ /

'a phrin las bzang po'i 'od zer gyis/ /mtha' yas mun rub rab bsal nas/ /dbu gtsang chos kyi rgyal khams su/ /byams pas skyong zhing brtan pa dang*/ /bstan la rim 'gro bgyis pa dang*/ /gnas skabs mthar thug legs byas la/ /skye dgu mtha' dag 'god par 'tshal/ /de dang de yi mdzad 'phrin la/ /gegs bral smon lam yang yang 'bul/ /zhes sogs bzhed don 'grub pa'i smon lam 'bul skyel dang bcas pa dang*/ 'di skabs smon lam gyi mjug tu/ dag pa'i 'jig rten dag tu rgyal ba'i mdzad pa dang*/ /skal bzang tshe na legs lam ji snyed mchis pa gang*/ /ma dag dus 'dir dge slong skad kyi ngo mtshar can/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i mdzad bzang bzhad par stsol/ /zhes bskal bzang sangs rgyas yin pa'i bsngags brjod gnang 'dug go /de mthun rje zhwa dmar bas kyang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rang lugs rmad byung ba/ /chos kyi rgyal bo thang pa chen po yi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi dus 'dir 'grub gyur nas/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sogs kyi gsol 'debs zhu yig bzhugs gdan dang bcas pa 'bul bar byung*/ hor zla bzhi pa'i nang gza' skar sbyor byed thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin gcig sgar grwa chen po bsgrigs par gnang*/ de nyin me tog gi char 'babs pa dang*/ 'ja' 'od la dge mtshan gyis ltas rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa'i rnam pa ji snyed dang bcas pa shar bas/ swog po'i mi rnams shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur/de nas rim gyis gdan btegs te/ snying drung dang 'dam sogs brgyud de hor smad pa'i sar phebs/ yang byang lam brgyud de 'bri chu la rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas sgrol te/ 'bri tshwa khar swog po'i phebs bsu ba rnams kyis slebs kyang rim gyis phebs pas/ cha rgan 'u su zhes pa'i sar swog po'i rgyal po a rbal gyis mjal zhing mchog tu dad pa thob/ snga sor gyi snyung res yang yang bsnyel ba yong gin yod 'dug la yon mchod rten 'brel khyad par can zhig gis yin snang ba/

swog yul du phebs tsam nyid nas dwangs/ dbu'i tshwa mtsho'i 'gram du rgyal po chen po a ba dan gyis spyan drangs pas kyang 'byor/ thog mar rgyal bo a rbal gyi brgyud pa yod pa'i sar phebs te/ rnyed bkur dang 'bul ba gzhal bar dka' ba byung zhing*/ slar yang gdan 'dren pas bskul te/ gu gu no'i mtsho 'gram du sprul pa'i rgyal po a ba dan khan dang mjal/ spyir ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang*/ snga sor rgyal po nyid kyi mnal lam du mtha' 'khob 'dul ba dang rgyal po nyid rjes su bzung nus pa'i bla ma zhig yang yang lung bstan par byung snang yang*/ sku'i dbyibs sogs rgyu mtshan du mas/ rje rin po che 'di nyid yin par yid ches/ bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gi don mdzad bzhin bzhugs pa la/ lho nas wa shul 'bum skyabs dar gyis nan gyis spyan drangs pa bzhin phebs pas/ 'khrugs pa bsdums pa dang dam pa'i chos kyis 'gro don dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyad par phyogs de'i dge 'dun bgrangs ba las 'das pa/ 'dus pa la chos 'khor rgya chen por bskor/ yos lo sar nas/ or rus pa'i be thu rgyal po dang*/ 'dzam thang ba'i bu chen karma bla mas spyan 'dren gyi pho nya byung ba bzhin/ rma chen spom ri'i gangs kyi mgul la sngon gzhan sus kyang ma bgrod pa'i lam zhig la rje nyid kyis cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa dang bcas byang phyogs la phebs/ rgyal po chen po al dan dang mjal dpal de bzhin gshegs pa stag lung ba chen po zhes mtshan gsol/ 'ja' sa ka 'o ming las zhwa las gos dngul srang brgyad cu gya lnga las grub pa'i tham ka /gzhan yang dngul stong phrag mang po 'bul ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ rgyal po chen po de nyid kyi sar 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul du grags pa/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ sprul pa'i sku thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpon slob kyis sgar du spyan drangs/

dge 'dun 'dus pa dpag tu med pa'i bsu ba dang mjal 'phrad phyag mnyam sogs kyi legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rgyal po chen pos kyang mjal/ 'phrad gzigs rtog mdzad cing*/ snga sor phyogs ris kyi brjod pa ci rigs pa thams cad ris med du zhi nas rgyal po chen po yang dad pa chen po sngar las kyang ches bla lhag tu skyes/ de nas rim gyis chibs kha bsgyur/ khri shor rgyal mo'i mtsho dang nye ba nas shar tsong kha'i cha la stag lung la gsar zhes zi ling nang sos spyan drangs/ drangs ti lnga mchod pas kyang spyan drangs shing zhabs tog phul du byung ba bsgrub/ rim gyis zi ling mkhar mo cher phebs/ rgya nag gong ma chen mo wan li'i bka' rtags kyi las ka 'dzin pa'i rgya'i mi dpon rnams kyis phun sum tshogs pa'i zhabs tog gis ri mor byas/ 'dzu lam cong rong du grags pa'i chu bo chen po la ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa dang bcas te dpon slob bde bar sgrol te/ rgya'i mi dpon zhig gis 'bul ba dang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung bo bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstabs/ rim pas o rus be thu dang karma bla ma sogs kyis bsnyen bkur zhabs tog dpag tu med pa mdzad/ swog phrug bcu phrag tsam rab tu byung nas zhabs 'bring du 'ong*/ gser dngul gos dar rta nor sogs dang mchod pa'i sprin gyi dngos po tshad gzhal bar dka' ba phul/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa/ rigs ldan sprul sku kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po'i rang lugs 'dzin pa/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug rlabs chen spyod pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba la 'gran zla dang bral ba/ sprul pa'i sku chen po rje btsun rgyal ba seng ges kyang ja zhus 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas legs so'i skyes dang 'dzam thang phyogs su slar yang phebs dgos pa'i snyan zhu tsam byung na'ang phyis phebs ni ma thub/ yos lo'i ston khar al dan rgyal pos dngul srang stong dang lnga brgya las grub pa'i dngul bzang*/

gzhan yang dngul spyad gtso bor gyur pa'i 'bul ba dpag tu med pa dang*/ gos dar gyi dos chen po bcu bzhi tsam 'bul ba sogs mu mtha' med pa'i mtshod rdzas phyag tu phebs/ de skabs rgyal po yab yum 'khor bcas la rgya bod du dam pa'i chos ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag dpag tu med pa nyin re bzhin gsungs pas/ sa skyong 'di lhag par dad de 'di phyi thams cad du skyabs gnas bslu ba med par shes shing*/ dpal kyai rdo rje la sogs pa bla med kyi dbang bka' mang pos smin par mdzad/ rjes gnang dang bka' lung grangs med par stsal/ rje 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma ches mchog tu 'dzin no/ /de nas dpon slob rnams or rgyus kyi rgyal po se chen hung tha'i tsis zhabs tog mu mtha' med par rgya chen mchod bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ rgya'i nang mi chur phebs mi dbon chen po kam chu du'u thang gis spyan drangs te rnyed bkur dpag tu med pa dang bcas/ sngon rgyal po go dan gyis btab pa'i pho brang lang gyur phebs khyad par 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khu dpon gyis btab pa'i shar phyogs sprul pa'i sder zhabs kyis bcags te/ de dang nye ba'i lho dbang sde/ nub pad+mo'i sde/ byang rgya mtsho'i sde/ zhes pa rnams su mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pas gtib par mdzad slar yang karma lha khang nas 'bul nod rgya chen po dang*/ or rgyus rgyal po'i dngul srang lnga brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal sogs 'bul/ mos pa dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ shing kun mkhar sogs mjal bar bzhed pa byung na'ang*/ tshad pa sogs kyis dgag dgos la brten nas ma phebs shing*/ de skabs kam chu du'u thang gi zhu ba la sprul pa'i sde'i gtsug lag mes bzhes pa'ang legs par zhig gsos grub pa dang*/ gzhan pad+mo'i sde la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di rnams sa paṇa khu dbon gyi dus nas yin zha

ི nga*/ bla ma khyed kyang sa skya'i rang lugs 'dzin pa la nye ba zhig yin par snang bas/ dgon gnas 'di rnams lha 'bangs dang bcas pa phyag tu 'bul bas cis kyang bzhugs par zhu zhes nan gyis zhu ba byung na'ang*/ bod yul gyi bstan pa la dgongs nas bzhugs par ma gnang*/ rim pas zi ling mkhar phyogs su phebs pas/ mkhar chen krong nang zhes pa nas 'ja' lam brgyud nas/ rgya'i skye bo che phra rnams la so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing thar pa'i lam la bkod nas/ rim gyis la gsar du phebs/ stag lung 'bum dpon gyi sar bzhugs pa'i skabs sde ba lhun 'grub rdzong pa 'di phyogs su 'das pa ye shes kyis gsal bar mkhyen te/ 'khor rnams la bka' bstsal/ de nas rim gyis dbus pa'i gdan 'dren rnams kyang 'byor/ rgya dang swog po'i skye bo mtha' yas pa chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de la spyir gong ma rgyal po tho gan the mur gyi rjes la bla ma rnam gnyis kyis ma byon phan chad du swog po rnams ni srin po'i spyod yul 'dzin pa dang*/ phyis ni rgya'i nang kun kyang mu stegs pa dang mthun pa'i zwin shing dang*/ stod hor stag gzig gi lugs sogs chos log mang zhing*/ bod nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams gzhan ma byon pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i phyogs kun yang chos tshul ngan par yod pa/ rje 'dis bstan pa'i srol rma med pa la bkod/ swog po'i yul kun du ni bsnyen gnas len pa dang*/ srog gcod spangs pa dang*/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa len pa sogs dpag tu med/ rje 'di nyid kyis don gsungs shing swog po'i pag shi mkhas pas/ za ma tog bkod pa sogs mdo sde mang po dang*/ gzhan yang rnam thar dang sgrub thabs mang po swog po'i skad du bsgyur zhing*/ las 'bras spangs blang gi gnas la mig phye bar mdzad do/ /'brug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la swog yul gzhi nas phyag btegs te/

de nas rim gyis byang lam brgyud/ gdan sa chen po stag lung thang du phyag phebs/ dbus gtsang gi dge 'dun gyi sde thams cad la sku skyes kyis tshul du mang ja dang*/ 'gyed bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pas dge 'dun rnams yid mgu ba thob par mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag spyan 'dren par mdzad de 'bul ba'i dngos po gya nom pa blos gzhal bar dka' ba dpag tu med pa stobs par mdzad cing*/ dam pa des kyang rje 'di nyid kyi drung du paṇ+ḍi ta chos mchog gi thugs dam rten phyag bzo mar grags pa'i thub pa'i dbang po'i sku li ma ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig 'bul bar mdzad/ phan tshun thugs lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dpe bral du bzhugs so/ /༈ rgyal ba bskyed mdzad khyed kyi gsang ba gsum/ /nam mkha'i rjes 'gro 'di la ci zhig brjod/ /'on kyang thugs rje'i 'od brgya shar ba las/ / mtha' 'khob sdig pa'i mun pa drung nas phyung*/ /klog dang bsam gtan tshul khrims ldan pa yis/ /rnam par gang ba'i sngon chad log lta'i yul/ /da ni rgyal ba'i zhing gi khud par gyur/ /ya mtshan 'di ni bla ma chos rje'i mthu/ /mtshon dang me char 'bebs ldan mchod 'os 'joms/ /'di dag rgyal ba'i 'phrin las can yin na/ /yid srub pho nya su zhig blo ldan dpyod/ /rje 'di kho na'i 'phrin las 'gro ba'i don/ /ces pa mtha' 'khob 'dul bar bstan pa sogs kyi mdzad pa las brtsam ste cung zad bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te drug pa'o// //de nas lcags mo sbrul lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i yar tshes dge ba zhig la srid 'di'i phun tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas ra sa 'phrul snang gi lha khang chen po'i/ gtsug lag khang*/ dbus ma jo bo rin po che nyid bzhugs pa'i steng gi gser phibs chen mo la zhig gsos bya bar dgongs nas/ gza' skar bzang ba zhig la dbu gtsugs/ zangs leb rnams thad brdung dang*/ gad brdar dgos pa rnams dang*/

phal cher gsar bzhengs su mdzad dgos pa dang*/ mda' yab sgor ma 'brug mgo bzhi dang bcas pa thams cad gsar du brdung te/ kun dril ba gser phibs chen mo 'di'i skud gser 'ba' zhig la/ gser zho stong phrag lnga kha 'thor ci rigs pas brgyan pa dang*/ dngul chu de'i drug bskor dang bcas pa shing cha thams cad gsar pa rjes tshon rtsi sogs dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi byang phyogs kyi 'khor phibs thams cad zhig gsos gnang ba dang*/ gzhan yang steng shod kun na zhig gsos mdzad dgos shin du mang por yod snang ba thams cad rdzogs par gnang zhing*/ 'di'i rgyu sogs gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dngul chu 'ba' zhig gi rin la'ang gzims dre'u nyis brgyar nye ba gnang ba sogs/ don gyi gtso bo sems can rnams mgu bar byed pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsgrub par bya ba yin pa ltar/ rin la brtseg pa dang*/ rgyu thabs kyis mgo bskor nas rang nyid tshong rgyal bar byed pa sogs gtan nas mi byed pa'i bka' khyab phyag g.yog so sor gnang nas rin yin lugs bzhin las kyang ches lhag tsam stsal ba sogs thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad du chos mthun 'ba' zhig gis bsgrub par gnang ba yin te/ sems can bslus nas sangs rgyas la mchod kyang bu bsad pa'i sha pha ma la drangs pa ltar rgyal ba mnyes pa'i lam las gol ba yin pa/ rgyal ba 'dis mkhyen zhing gzigs pas yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa yin te/ dpyod ldan rnams kyis kyang 'di bzhin du byos shig /de skabs su bal bo nyi shu lhag cig dang*/ ri mo ba/ shing bzo ba/ rdo bzo ba/ ja lag pa sogs bzo pa nyis brgya skor gyi chas phog mar gnang zhing*/ grangs su ma btab pa'i longs spyod ni gzhal du med/ thugs rje'i mthus de bar 'thab 'khrug na ba sogs cung zad med pa/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du phal cher grub nas/ thub pa'i ring bsrel dang gzungs bzhugs 'khor lo sogs nang bzhugs khyad par can rnams kyis phyur bur gtams pa/

gañdzi ra lngas yongs su mdzes par mdzad/ dpal ri bo dga' ldan gyi khri thog pa dang*/ dge slong sdom brtson bsnyen pa song ba brgya phrag mang bo'i 'khor dang bcas nas rab gnas zhal gror bcas pa mdzad/ kyi shod pa'i zhal ngo'i thog drangs/ dpag tu med pa la dga' ston rgya chen po dang*/ rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon nas brtsam gang la gang dgos thams cad la gnang sbyin dpe bral du stsal/ khyad par bal po rnams la gser 'dab kyi yon sogs bzo bo rnams la gnang sbyin blo 'das dang*/ lha sar sde bzhir ja dang tshwa'i sgo 'gyed sogs lha sa'i zhig gsos 'di'i skabs su ji ltar gnang ba'i rnam gzhag rnams zhib mor brjod na ni nyin zhag mang pos kyang rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni da ltar gyi dus na rig sngags dang g.yo thabs dang tshul 'chos la sogs pa ngan thabs thams cad kyis longs spyod rgya cher bsgrub nas/ bdag dang gzhan bag med pa'i rgyur sbyor ba'i log 'tsho dang*/ zhing ma yin pa rgyal po sdig can rnams lag 'gyangs kyis mgu bar byas nas rang phyogs su bsdu bar byed pa dang*/ ser sna'i dbang gis mi sbyin mi spyod par rnam par 'chums shing gnas pa dang*/ kha cig ni longs spyod gya nom pa thams cad 'dre rgod mi srun pa dag la rnam par gtad de/ rang phyogs 'phel ba'i phyir de la snying thag pa nas gsol ba btab pas/ des kyang de dag gla rngan du bzung nas skal ba dman pa rnams kyi sems rgyud bskul te/ de'i phyogs la nye bar sbyor bar byed pa tsam zhig la snying por byed pa sogs log pa'i 'tsho ba lhur len pa rnams la khrel bsdas chen po mdzad pa'o/ /'dis ni bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad 'phral du nye bar zhi nas/ dpal stag lung pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa zla ba yar ngo ltar 'phel rgyas su gyur pa 'di yin no/ /der skabs dang mthun par klu sgrub kyis phyag bzo'i ghan dho la ngo mtshar can de la/

tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i dri gtsang khang phyung ba'i zab brkos dang bcas pa legs par grub cing*/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i thugs dam gyi thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan bla med legs pa'i rtser son pa de nyid nang du bzhugs par mdzad/ 'di ni da ltar yang sku dang 'bral med du phyag mchod kyi rten du bzhugs pa lags/ swog yul nas phebs 'phral stag lung gi dge 'dun spyi la/ gling gi zhig gsos kyi thes su gnang sbyin spung che bstsal 'dug pas/ 'di las nges par gling 'di la lcags ri zhig grub na legs zhes thams cad blo gros gcig tu gyur pa nas/ stag lo hor zla bzhi pa'i gnam gang gza' skar dge ba la zhabs kyis bcags shing phyag nas gnang*/ phyis rim pas legs par grub ste shin tu rgya che ba 'di tsam la'ang de dang der nyes skyon gyi rnam pa cung zad tsam yang med par grub pa yin no/ /lo 'di nyid kyi dbyar smad du bdag gis gsol ba btab cing spyan drangs pas phebs pa'i lam du/ hor stod pas rnyed bkur 'bul nod kyis mchod rim gyis lam du 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po dang bcas te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang chen po chos lung byang rtser phyag phebs/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar ba bsgrang bar mi spyod pa bzhugs pa thams cad la kun du bzang bo'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bus mchod par mdzad/ de skabs don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas dang*/ rgyal ba kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo rje grub chen rin po che lha dbang grags pa dang*/ rje drung rin po che kun dga' dpal bzang po dang*/ bstan 'dzin sprul sku rin po che sogs bla ma che dgu mkhas shing grub pa zad mi shes pa zhal 'dzoms shing*/ thams cad kyis kyang dam pa 'di nyid la phu dud du bkur ba dang*/

bka' chos kyi 'brel ba re gsan/ rje 'dis kyang rje btsun rdo ring ba chen po kun dga'i mtshan can la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang sogs dang*/ rje thub pa'i dbang phyug la yang 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs dang*/ ras chung snyan brgyud kyi chos skor ma lus pa dang*/ dpal mgon drag shad kyi skor sogs mtha' yas pa'i chos sgo gsan zha
