ི nga*/ gzhan yang bdag cag der 'dus pa kun la ni chos dang zang zing gi 'byor pas nyin mtshan kun du 'da' bar gyur te/ bdag gis kyang rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po zhus shing*/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa'i bar gyis bka' drin nod do/ / gzhan yang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba dang*/ so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun pa'i chos zhu ba sogs dam pa'i chos kyi 'gro don gyis la stod kyi phyogs thams cad khyab par mdzad do/ /rim pas ri khrod chen mo mjal ba la jo mo nang du phebs pa na/ chos rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis myos pa'i sgrub pa mo rnams kyis phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te spyan drangs/ der bzhugs kyi sgrub pa pho mo thams cad dang*/ dad 'dun gyi skye bo stong phrag mang pa la chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ slar yang 'jeng*/ rta nag shings sogs phebs lam gyi yul thams cad du dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa la chos dang 'byor pas tshim par mdzad/ gang dang gang du phebs pa de dang der 'di nyid kho na mi tshogs che zhing mos shugs che la/ chos kyis 'gro don yang de tsam du che'o snyam pa sha stag byung ngo*/ /de nas slar yang gdan sa nyid du phebs shing*/ de'i phyir lo gtso bo yang dag 'jog gnang zhing bar bar du 'gro ba'i don yang rgya cher mdzad/ spre'u lo swog po'i yul du dad can rnams kyis phul ba'i gos chen la sogs pa swog po'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa rnams dge ba las kyang dge ba srid mtha'i bar du bskrun par bzhed nas/ sprul sku sman thang pa blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ 'bras spungs sogs nas gos sku bzhengs pa la bzo ris mkhas pa rtser son pa sha stag bsdu bar gnang*/ phyis kyi gos chen las bzang thag chod pa 'ba' zhig la/ gos yug bcos med stong dang brgyad brgya tsam thog mar 'don pa gnang zhing*/ de dag gi sder lus ci rigs la phyis gzhan dang gzhan yang bsnan te/

mdor na zab chen yug stong phrag gnyis tsam las bsgrub pas thub chen gyi gos sku lha mgron mang po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rtse mchod khang gi gtsug lag khang chen mo las kyang ches dpangs mtho zhing*/ zhing du'ang de mtshungs su yod pa 'di nyid bzhengs par gnang ba'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung ba dang*/ rje 'di nyid khu dpon 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes te/ rab gnas kyi me tog gtor ba gnang ba'i skabs me tog gi char yid ches mngon rtags can phebs pa yun ring du byung*/ bkra shis dge mtshan dpag tu med pa'i gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs par snang ngo*/ /༈ kuna~X gnas ngo mtshar rab dga~X'i bsti gnas mchog /bkra~X shisa~X 'phrul snang dge bar spyod pa las/ /mi mthun g.yul nas rgyal ba'i rgyala~X mtsha~Xn brnyes/ /'gro ba'i dpa~Xl gyur bza~Xng po~X khyod nyid kyi/ /'gro don 'phrin las pha mtha' bgrang yas 'di/ /mngon 'gyur rnams la'ang gzhal bar mi nus na/ / lkog tu gyur la su zhig tshad 'jal byed/ khyod nyid kho nas khyod kyi rnam thar mkhyen/ /zhes pa khyad par gyi mdzad pa 'ba' zhig las brtsam ste cung zad bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te bdun pa'o// //bla ma de nyid kyi thugs rjes gos sku snga phyir bzhengs par mdzad pa thams cad la skya ris la spo len mi dgos pa dang*/ gos chen bsgrig pa'i tshe dang tshon yig sogs mi dgos par yid tsam gyi 'grig pa sogs ya mtshan dpag tu med pa byung ngo*/ /de nas shing mo bya lo la/ stag lung ma thang du grags pa dpal ri bo che nas spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya ba rnams kyis kyang bskul te/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku chen po rgyal tshab tu mngon par dbang bskur nas/ dpal ri bo cher phebs pa'i sgar grwa bsgrig par mdzad cing*/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyis phebs skyel la phebs/ myur du slar phebs pa'i rten 'brel du phebs skyel ba rnams la chos drug yid bzhin nor bu'i mgo btsugs tsam gnang*/

lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya mthil phyin dang myur du phebs pa'i zhal bzhes kyis dbug dbyung rim pas hor stod smad dang a grags sogs kyi ri khrod brgyud nas/ dpal ri bo che dang nye bar phebs bsu ja 'dren snga phyi rim pa gsum tsam dang*/ de nas nye bar sde pa mgon po rdo rje dpon g.yog gis chibs bsu dang*/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu rnams kyis mdun brdar te phebs bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu/ 'dren pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ma nyams pa gcig pu ba/ mkhas btsun bzang pa ོ sa mthar thug dngos grub mchog gi gnas brnyes pa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rin po che mtsho skyes rdo rjes nyid kyang gtsug lag khang gi sgo drung du phebs bsur phebs shing*/ mjal ba tsam gyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres te/ shin tu thugs phebs pa'i dgyes pa chen pos gtam gyis mtshams sbyor te/ rje 'di nyid kyis kyang sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhal snga nas la/ rje rin po che sangs rgyas dbon grags pa dpal gyis bka' 'bum pod chen bdun gyi lung dang*/ de ka'i nang na bzhugs so cog gi dbang bka' byin rlabs rje gnang rab 'byams 'byams klas pa dang*/ stag lung bka' brgyud/ rgya gar gyi grub chen dzñā na ta pa'i gdams ngag sogs khrid bka' dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa dang*/ khyad par stag lung bka' brgyud nyid kyi gdam ngag rje bkra shis bla ma man chad du stag lung ma thang na yang mi bzhugs pa ji snyed gcig gsan zha ི nga*/ rdo rje theg pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor yang dpag tu med pa gsan/ rje 'di nyid kyis bla ma dam pa de nyid la yang*/ gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis bzhed srol bla med kyi dkyil 'khor mang por dbang bskur pa dang*/ gzhan yang stag lung ma thang nas brgyud pa'i zab chos dpag tu med pa gnang*/

dbon rin po che sku phra mor bzhugs pa'ang rje 'di nyid kyi sku drung du dbu skra bsil/ spyir rje drung rin po che mtsho skyes rdo rje de nyid/ lugs gnyis char nas dgongs pa'i rgya mtshor bzhugs pas/ dpal stag lung ba'i gdan sa gong 'og gnyis chos brgyud kyi khungs 'dod pa gcig pa tsam du ma zad/ thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi chos thams cad thig gcig spar gcig tu bzhugs mod/ rje rin po che bkra shis bla ma nas bzung bde gshegs rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi bar du gdan sa yar mar ha cang thugs 'brel che ba ma byung 'dug pas kyang*/ rang lugs kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa la rang rkang tshugs par ma byung zhing*/ dus tshod 'di skabs na rje drung rin po che nyid kyang sku na tshod smin pa dang*/ dbon rin po che yang sku phra ba sogs kyi rje rin po che 'di nyid ma phebs na rim pas grwa rigs gsar pa kun ni nyi ma gang dro dang gong gang che'i rnam pas/ kar lugs sogs la 'gyur ba'i gnas kyang yod par dgongs nas/ rje 'di nyid ched kyi spyan 'dren par yang mdzad pa yin snang la/ gzhan yang bka' bstsal la/ ma thang gi gtsug lag khang mes bzhes pa sogs kyis da lta byin rlabs rten sogs ri bo che nyid ches bkang bar bzhugs pas/ bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam rten sogs gtos che ba 'bul/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de ka bzhin phyag tu 'bul bar mdzad pa yang*/ thang pa chen po nyid kyi thugs dam 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa'i dngul sku khri rgyab can dang*/ rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyi thugs bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung bkra shis 'od 'bar sku yal rin po che rin chen mgon po sogs kyi/ dngul sku rgyab yol can phyag nas ma mang po/ klu 'jim gyi mdzad brgya/ rdo rje 'chang gi dngul sku rgyab yol ma grub thob brgyad cu'i tshogs kyi sku'i bkod pa can/ 'dzam bus gling na bzo bkod legs pa'i dper bzhag pa sogs thugs dam rten bris 'bur gyi tshogs ngo mtshar ba can mtha' yas pa dang rje btsun mar pa nas brtsams brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi dbu skra dang na bza' sogs byin rlabs kyi rten cha tshang ba/

sangs rgyas dbon gyi bka' 'bum tshar gnyis dang*/ gzhan yang phyag dpe dkon pa mang po dang*/ dwangs shel gyi spos phor/ gzi yon chen gyi gsol khrab sogs khyad par nor mang po phyag tu phul/ bar skabs shig tu zur mang dang karma pa'i phyogs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis spyan drangs/ khong rnams kyi blo dang mthun par karma kam tshang gi zab chos mang po'i 'khor lo bskor bas sems can tshim par mdzad/ sgom sde nang chen pas spyan drangs/ 'bul ba'i dngos po rgya cher phul/ tshogs bdag gis chos skor sogs blo dang mthun pa'i chos mang du gnang*/ slar yang dpal ri bo cher phebs te/ stag lung gi gdan sa yar mar gnyis chos dang srid kyi 'phrin las thams cad sgo gcig tu 'gyur bar bka' bgros/ 'bul nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas/ phan tshun thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i thugs lhag par 'phreng bzhin pas phebs skyel gyi bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas rim pas yar phebs/ phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer lnga la stag lung thang du phebs shing*/ ri bor cher gsan pa'i bka' chos rnams dang*/ zhal thang sogs byin rlabs can mang po mchog gi sprul pa'i sku la skyes kyis tshul du 'bul ba gnang*/ dpal stag lung thang gi gtsug lag khang chen mo'i steng gi gser phibs snga gong nas rim pas phal cher grub na'ang*/ lhag ma rnams skabs 'dir zhabs mjug rdzogs par gnang zhing*/ byang rā sgreng du phebs skabs shig /de nyid du bzhugs pa'i thugs dam pa bgres po zhig gis rang gi rdzas gang yod gser du bsgyur ba'i gser zho kha shas gcig phyag tu phul nas/ lha khang ka gnyis ma'i gser thog gser gdan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan phul bas nye bar thugs bskul te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams gnas mchog de'i gnad kyi snying po/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku dngos byon sogs byin rlabs kyi gzi byin mu mtha' med pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang ka gnyis ma'i gser thog de nyid sngon dus skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gis cung zad mgo rtsom par mdzad kyang 'phror lus nas phal cher ma grub pa la yongs su rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i zhal bkod gnang nas ring por mi thogs par legs par grub/

'di'i skud gser la yang gser zho drug brgya lhag gcig song zhing*/ de ka'i yon dang rab gnas kyi bar du rgya cher gnang ngo*/ /'di na gang gi mdzad pa bgrang yas kyang*/ /thams cad gzhan la phan pa 'ba' zhig lags/ /ris med mchod pa'i yul rnams mchod pa dang*/ /ris med dam chos rgya cher spel bar mdzad/ /dam chos bdud rtsi nub par nye ba rnams/ /mgon po khyod kyis shin du dar bar mdzad/ /dbyar dus chu bo rgyas la ngo mtshar ci/ /dkon pa tsam du rin thang che zhes grags/ /bzang ngan mi dpyod rang phyogs kho na zhes/ /snying la brnag pa'ang gzhan lugs skyon med dag / smod byed chen po dag gis yid 'jigs nas/ /skyabs gnas skyabs mchog khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas par mdzad pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig las brtsam ste bsnyad pa'i gtam ste brgyad pa'o// //glang lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang rnam rgyal kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyang*/ rje 'di nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad cing*/ slob dpon du 'os pa gnyis dang*/ grib tshod pa dang dad pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/ ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga bzhags par mi 'os pas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de skabs su sog po'i rgyal bo a sbal gyis nan ches kyis phebs par gsol ba btab pa'i pho nya ba'ang sku drung du bcar sdod du yod cing*/ spyir sku na tshod smin pa dang sog yul thag ring zhing bgrod dka' ba sogs rgyu mtshan du mas/ grwa bu slob yon bdag sde dpon so so thams cad dang*/ bdag cag phyogs mtha' ba thams cad kyis kyang me phebs par bzhugs pa'i gsol ba btab kyang*/ rje nyid dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis chos thams cad sgrib med gcig char du gzigs pa'i bka' las/ da lan cis kyang sog yul du 'gro dgos yod cing*/ lo gsum nas nges par nyes skyon med par 'khor 'ong zhes zhal bzhes bzang pa

ོ sa bdag cag re ltos bcas thams cad la dbugs 'byin par gnang*/ hor zla drug pa'i nang du dpon slob rnams gdan sa nyid nas phyag btegs/ hor stod nas dpon sas mjal bar phebs/ lam gyi sems can rnams kyi don rgya cher gnang nas byang lam bsrang nas phebs pas 'bri chu shin du rgyas pa la phyag nas gnang ba tsam gyis chung ngu song nas dpon slob rnams nye zho med par phar thon/ de bzhin du rma chu la yang phyag nas gnang bas de bzhin du byung zhing*/ dpon slob rnams chab kyi pha kar thon 'phral chu ni sngar lugs bzhin rgyas nas 'dug zer/ chu bo chen po gcig la nyag gcig yong bar 'dug pa chad nas gzhan rnams kyis ci byar yang med pa gcig byung 'dug pa/ rje nyid kyi dgongs pas dpyad de lam sna gnang brgal phebs 'dug pa thams cad bde bar thon de/ slar yang de ma thag chu'i gting bltas dus rab tshugs pa'i sa gtan med par 'dug /de nas rim gyis dab phyi thu ru sog po'i gdan 'dren pa rnams kyang slebs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho zhing brdzes pa'i gtam byung bas phyag g.yog rnams sems 'jigs pa la/ rje nyid kyis rang re rnams la nyes skyon med ces dbugs 'byin par mdzad pas yid bde ba la bkod/ de nas mtsho skya rengs dang sngo rengs gnyis kyi bar gyi lam bzung nas phebs pas/ chal phyi zhes pa'i bar rim gyis phebs shing*/ thog mar a sbal gyi dpon mo mjal du byung*/ slar mi phyed pa'i dad pa can gyi rgyal po a sbal nyid kyis spyan drangs/ rgyal bu nyid bro tshabs chen po zhig gis btab nas yun ring po lon pa sman dpyad sogs gang gis phan par ma byung snang ba/ rje rin po che nyid phebs nas khrus chog dbang bka' sogs gnang ba dang*/ bka' bstsal ltar gyi zas spyod bgyis pa tsam gyis nad tshab chen po yang 'phral nyid nas je drag la song*/ phebs skor 'di la sngar gyi yon bdag rnying pa thams cad kyis kyang sngar srol gyi lugs kho nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gus pa chen pos mchod cing*/

bod char gtogs pa'i a rag gi sde rnams su yang 'phrin las kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing*/ stag lo'i nang du tho ye shes kyi rgyal po chen po al dan gyi tsha bo pe chen khan gyis spyan drangs/ rgyal mo kha thun sogs thams cad kyis mjal/ mchog tu gus pa chen pos 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing*/ rang rang so so'i blo dang mtshungs par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ 'di skabs kyang tsong kha'i sa cha stag lung la gsar lha khang du*/ mda' dar 'bum dpon gyis spyan drangs shing rnyed bkur byas/ sa phyogs de rnams su chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ sog po'i rgyal po gu yeng tsong chi des ching gis spyan drangs nas chos 'brel mang du zhus/ de nas rim pas o rus ju lang rgyal pos spyan drangs/ snga ma bzhin du 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'brug gi lo la tho mis kyi rgyal po 'khor lo ching bas ngur gyis spyan drangs/ phebs bsu'i tshe mchog tu dkar ba'i rta mchog bcu gsum dar dkar yug gi mthur mda' dang bcas te phul/ mjal ba tsam gyis mchog tu gus pa chen po thob nas chos mang du zhus shing*/ dngul gzhong mang por mar me sbar nas 'bul ba sogs mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa blo las 'das pa byung*/ rje 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma mthar thug tu 'dzin zha

ི nga mi phyed pa'i dad pa gzhan dang mi mnyam pa thob/ de nas dus skabs bde bar byung na/ sog yul mthul gyi rgyal po gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang spyan 'dren pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu yod par snang bas/ lo mang po'i bar du phebs thub pa dka' ba 'dug kyang rje nyid kyi ye shes kyis gzigs pas bka' stsal phebs pa de kho na bzhin yin par snang bas/ rgya dang sog po 'thab dgos pa'i stabs nas/ rgyal brgyud so so gzhan dang gzhan dag gis sku gzhogs su ja 'dren myur du 'byor zhing spyan 'dren sogs 'phral sleb ma byung ba'i bar la/ yar phebs pa'i dgongs gtad gnang ba phyag thog tu khel thub ste/ 'di ni 'o skol kha ba can pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthu'o/ /yar phebs pa'i lam du yi ge sba khom zhes pa'i sa char sgar byings rnams logs zhig na yod cing*/ gzims gur cung zad 'gol sa zhig na yod pa/ nam phyed tsam zhig gi dus sku gzhogs na mi su yang med pa la/ bka' bstsal mang po zhig gnang gin 'dug pa/ de dang nye ba na mchod g.yog pas thos te/ bla rdol gyi gsungs yin nam snyam du sems nas snyan du phul bas kha rog sdod gsungs/ phyi rol tu bltar song bas/ gzims gur gyi logs na bya shin tu che ba gshogs sgro re la'ang 'dom gnyis re tsam yod pa zhig rje rin po che'i phyogs la 'dud par byed pa zhig 'dug pa mthong ba na/ drung du btud pas 'phur thabs la mi snang bar song ngo*/ /nang du 'ong bas de nyid mkhyen te/ bya de'i drung du khyod kyis btud pa ma legs/ khyed rnams kyis byar mthong ba yin gyi/ rma chen sbom ra 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir 'ong nas chos gtam 'phel bdo pa'i skabs yin pa la/ de la chos gtam gyi bar chad cung zad byung gsungs/ de nas rim gyis byang lam brgyud nas myur shar du phebs pas/ rim pas 'bri chu gos gong la ru phebs pa'i tshe/ gnyan chen thang lhas phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po'i gzigs snang byung bar snang*/

byang lam brgyud pa'i stabs sa yang mtho rab tu phebs/ 'brug lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang yin na'ang*/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs shing sa chu dros song ste/ 'khyags pa'i zhun chu la mi thar pa tsam byung zhing*/ gdan sa chen po stag lung du phebs pa dang*/ thang pa rin po che'i dngul sku phyag nas ma'i rgyab yol/ rgya khyon bzo bkod rgyu tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa de nyid legs par grub pa'i rab gnas dga' ston dang 'dzoms/ mchog tu bkra shis shing rten 'brel 'grigs so/ /༈ yul gang dam chos snang ba rgyas mdzad nas/ /slar yang kuna~X tu dga~X' ba rdo rje'i gnas/ /bkra~X shi~Xs rnama~X par rgyala~X ba'i khang bzang mchog /lhun po'i spo la mgon po mchog nyid bzhugs/ /dus gsum shes bya'i gnas la ye shes ni/ /rnam bkra'i gzugs la mig gis blta ba bzhin/ /ma nor mkhyen pa'i bka' stsal mngon sum gyur/ /mi shes yid kyi ri mor 'bri ba ni/ /mkhyen ldan rnams kyis mchog tu 'grel ba'i gnas/ /'on kyang blun po rtag tu rang blos spyod/ /'di yang shin tu rmad byung 'ba' zhig lags/ /zhes pa 'phags pa'i bka' mchog tu mi bslu ba las brtsams te bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te dgu pa'o// // sog yul du phebs pa'i bar la rje 'di nyid kyi lcam du gyur pa dpon sa rnam rgyal dpa' mo gshegs pa'i nang rten du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bden gnyis zhal can gyi sku brnyan mi tshad chung tsam zhig /bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pas lag 'phrul las sngags sku gser zangs las bzhengs pa la mtshar ba'i dper thon pa zhig bsgrub par mdzad/ gzungs bzhugs la sogs pa'i rim pa thams cad gzab rgyas su gnang*/ de nas rim pas 'khor lo bde mchog gi gser sku/ rje btsun ma de nyid dang sku tshad mnyam pa zhig dang*/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas dang 'gro ba'i mgon po a ti sha 'brom ston chen po rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rnams kyi sku brnyan mi tshad ma re re bzhengs par gnang zhing*/

gzungs bzhugs dang rab tu gnas pa'i bar zab rgyas su gnang*/ de dag gi bar du yang hor dang bod kyi 'gro don mdzad pa ni dpag tu med/ de nas 'brug lo'i nang bdag cag stod phyogs na yod pa'i skabs shig sgro rong nas gzims dpon nam mkha' 'bod mir gnang byung ba bzhin/ sku gzhogs su 'byor/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bka' drin du zhus pa yang bstsal/ de nas sog yul du phebs pa'i skabs dad can rnams kyis phul ba'i gos yug shin tu mang ba phyag tu bzhugs pa rnams/ snga ma bzhin 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi rten bsgrub par bzhed te/ gos sku snga ma'i skabs las kyang ches rgyu tshogs bzang po'i gos sku khyad par can bsgrub par dgongs shing*/ 'di skabs kyang gos yug chen po stong phrag skor song zhing*/ jus gsar rnying sngo ljang mchin kha sogs gser ma ches shin tu bzang ba rang yang dpag tu med pa 'don par mdzad 'du byed pa sprul sku sman thang ba sogs kyang bka' bstsal gyis bsdu bar mdzad de/ rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi nub phyogs kyi sa khad snyoms pa zhig tu/ gza' tshes dge ba la sprul sku sman thang bas skya ris btab nyi ma gnyis tsam la skya ris rnams yongs su rdzogs/ de 'phral du rtse'i mchod khang zhig gi khyams su bzo pa rnams kyis bzo btsugs te/ zla ba gcig lhag tsam nas yongs su rdzogs par 'grub/ 'di yang sngar gyi gos sku chen mo'i 'khor gyi tshul du/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug /rgyal chen bzhi/ ha shang*/ dharma ta la/ gzhan yang lha chen 'ga' zhig dang bcas dkyus kyi ring thung gos sku chen mo dang mnyam zhing*/ zhing ni gnyis kar la phan tshun 'dom drug tsam yin pa/ bzo khyad mtshar ba'i phul du phyin pa byung*/ gza' tshes bzang ba la bdag la rab gnas gyis zhes bka' stsal te/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye zhing*/ rab gnas kyi cho ga byings rnams legs par grub pa na/

gtsug lag khang gi byang dngos su legs par bkram ste/ 'dren pa khu dbon gnyis gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad kyis brtan bzhugs shis brjod dang bcas te me tog gtor/ de skabs nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim rim brtsegs mang po dang*/ me tog gi char 'bebs shing nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang pa ོ byung*/ de nas slar yang mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la chos kyi rje rin po che nyid bzhugs pa la/ bdag cag rnams kyis shis brjod mnga' gsol bgyis/ rje btsun bla ma sku tshe brtan pa la sogs pa'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'grig par nges shes skyes/ nyin phyed tsam la bstan pa'i gtso bo rje btsun khu dbon rnam gnyis sku chas shin tu zab pa sogs kyis mthong ba tsam gyis mchog tu zil che ba'i sku'i rnam cha rin po che'i khri la zhabs zungs brtan par mdzad/ phyag phyir bdag dang mkhas pa'i dbang po dus zhabs pa chen po byams pa lhun grub pa dang*/ drung pa ka drug pa dang*/ drung pa dkyil srang ba dang*/ drung pa 'ol ba sogs/ bla ma slob dpon shin tu mang ba dang*/ lha bzo ba gnas brtan chen po blo bzang rgya mtsho ba la sogs pa bzo ris pa thams cad dang*/ grwa nang gling gsum gyi mi sde la sogs pa'i drag bsdus 'ba' zhig pa la grwa pa lnga rgya tsam byung zhing*/ lha khang shod go mtshams med par gang ba'i ston mo'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gtsang zhing gya nom pa/ sngon thub pa chen po 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ lha dang mi yi rgyal po rnams kyis bsnyen bkur ba'i rnam cha la yang 'di lta bu'o/ /zhes rjes su dpog par bskyed cing*/ bdag cag rab gnas bgyi ba rnams nas brtsams gang la gang 'os kyi yon rdzongs gnang sbyin gzhal bar dka' bas gtsug lag khang chen mo de nyid kyang bun long du gyur zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan nam mkha' la reg par gyur to/

/de dus bdag gis kyang sku drung du zla ba bzhir nye bar bsdad cing*/ bka' bstsal nan gyis gnang ba la brten nas/ bdag lta bu la 'bul ba'i nus pa gtan med kyang*/ bla ma'i bka' bstsal de nyid byin rlabs kyi sgo yin par bsam nas/ dgongs bzhed kyi chos thams cad 'bul ba'i lugs su bgyis/ de dag kyang bsam mi khyab kyi yan lag bla ma sgrub pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po ye shes 'char ba/ dran pa gcig pa/ sgron me gcig pa/ yan lag drug la/ dzā lan dha ra'i do ha'i skor/ sems kyi phyag rgya yi ge bzhi pa/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa dang*/ rngon pa'i gdam ngag /phag mo sna tshogs mdog /phag mo keng rus la bzhugs pa/ rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma/ khams gsum dbang bsdud kyi spyan ras gzigs/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rigs gsum tsam/ phag mo ca co sgrogs ma/ bdag med ma dang ba'i rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang*/ bka' babs bdun ldan gyi skor rnams te slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pa nas brgyud pa rnams dang*/ sa lugs kyi dmar mo skor gsum la sogs pa mang du phul/ bdag phyir 'ong khar brtan bzhugs zab rgyas su phul nas/ myur du mjal bar smon lam btab nas stod phyogs la 'ong zhing*/ dus 'di skabs phyin chad nas phal cher rnam rgyal rab brtan nyid du yang dag 'jog nyid la gtso bor bzhugs shing*/ rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi mdun ngos kyi ri de la sa dpyad la/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ gu ru pad+ma sam bha wa dang*/ nor bu dga' 'khyil gyi gzugs brnyan 'dra rung du yod pa de rnams dngos su ye shes kyi gzigs pa'i gsal snang la yang yang shar/ 'di ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams gnas chen byin rlabs can gyi tshul du yang sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par bshad pa bzhin/ ji lta ba'i dngos gnas kyi gnas tshul gzigs pa yin gyi nyams kyis snang ba tsam ni ma yin

no/ /de'i phyir de dag sa rdo phal par blta bar mi bya'o/ lug lor rnam rgyal rab brtan du mgon khang gsar bzhengs gnang*/ la stod nyi shar ba yin pa'i lha bzo blun blun 'dra ba zhig gis 'du byas pa'i ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sman sku dngos byon 'di nyid bzhengs par gnang ste/ mgon sku de ni bzo khyad mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa'i rig byed pa mtha' yas pa'i blo gros bsdu bar yang*/ blo la mi 'char ba'i bzo bkod phun sum tshogs par rang byung 'dug cing*/ sku la nam yang rdul mi chags pa/ sku tshad dngos gnas la mi tshad gzhon tsam du 'dug na'ang ma brtags pa'i tshe sku tshad ches che ba ltar snang ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis dga' ba dang 'jigs pa dang bag dro ba dang*/ dpa' nyams skye ba la sogs pa'i sems nyams du ma 'char thub pa zhig snang ste/ 'di bzhengs pa'i skabs su shin tu 'tshub 'gyur che ba byung zhing*/ mtshan mo lta ci smos nyin mo yang sa phyogs der zil gyis mi tshug pa tsam byung 'dug cing*/ khyad par lha bzos dngos su mthong ba la/ khyi nag shin tu che ba me stag lta bu'i mig yod pa zhig khong rang gi rtsar mngon sum du byung*/ gzhan yang me 'bar ba sogs cho 'phrul mang du byung bar snang*/ 'di'i gzungs bzhugs su dpal chen rga lo'i thugs dam rten la sogs pa byin rlabs rten dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ de nyid mgon khang du spyan 'dren pa mdzad do/ /gzhan yang gnyan thog pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi thugs dam rten/ bde mchog mgon po phur ba/ gshin rje gshed la sogs pa byin rlabs can gyi rten du ma dang*/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi rten sku byin rlabs can phyag bzhengs gnang ba yang*/ khang bzang dang bcas pa rten 'brel du ma dang bcas pa'i bzhugs su gsol spyan gzigs mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa gtibs par gnang*/ yang mgon po'i dngul sku rkang gang ma zhig kyang bzhengs par gnang zhing*/

snga phyi zhal thang bzhengs par gnang ba ni bgrang bar mi spyod pas ma bris so/ /gzhan yang rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi gnas mchog 'dir/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i zhal gzigs yang lan mang du byung bar snang*/ lo re bzhin dbyar thog la sku chab mtshan tu bzhugs pa re gnang ba dang sbrags/ byang phyogs kyi 'brog ris dang*/ hor sogs kyi 'gro don rgya cher gnang nas phal cher gnas mchog dam pa rnam rgyal rab brtan nyid du gdan phebs/ rim par gzim khang tshom chen sogs kyang legs par grub/ de nas bzhugs yul ye 'ur mdzad cing*/ der phyin mi dang phyag g.yog byings mi 'gro zhing*/ dpon slob nyung bsdus tsam phyi mtshams kho nas bzhugs pa dang*/ don mi 'gang che ba rnams la yug re tshoms chen du mjal 'phrad gnang*/ gzhan ngor tshul ston pa la 'di skabs thugs dam rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba la/ snga dgong gzhan gang las kyang bogs che ba'i tshul du byung*/ sngon skyer rgang ba chen po la/ te se'i ri pa rnams kyis zhus pa ltar 'dug pa dam pa 'dis sngon du bsnyen pa ched du gnang ba rnams phar bzhags/ da lta mi tshig dang 'dres mar gsungs bzlas gnang ba rnams kyang grangs ma btab/ lha gzhan dang gzhan gyi gsungs bzlas gnang ba rnams kyang bor nas/ nyin mtshan snga dgong so so'i thugs dam thun gyi gsungs bzlas 'ba' zhig bsag pa la'ang*/ phyag 'phreng snga ma zhig gi steng nas bde mchog gi nye snying rang yang dung phyur du nye ba tsam dang*/ da lta'i phyag 'phreng 'di ka'i steng nas ni dung phyur lhag tsam yang song bar snang ngo*/ /thugs dam gyi rim pa gzhan yang 'dis dpag par nus pas/ rgyal ba rgod tshang ba chen po spros med kyi ngang nas spros bcas kyi thugs dam mi bcus kyang mi zin pa tsam mdzad par grags pa yang 'di las gzhan du ci/ khyi lo'i dbyar smad kyi dus gsol gyi snyung ro langs pa'i rnam pas/ sku shin tu bsnyel ba'i tshul gyi sku khams dub par bzhugs pa la/

sman dpyad sogs kyis 'phrod brten cis legs lam 'bul bzhin yod pa'i skabs/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs kyis bdud rtsi'i ril bu sgrub par gnang bas sku skal 'bul ba'i gdong grogs bdag la gyis zhes bka' bkod gnang ba dang*/ bdag gi rmi lam gyi ltas la/ rje nyid mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis spyan 'dren pa ltar 'dug pa la/ bdag gis gsol ba drag tu btab pas bshol thebs pa'i snang ba zhig byung ba la brten/ brtan bzhugs shig dang sbrags pho nya zung 'brel myur shan du brdzangs/ khong rnams kyis sku drung du phyin dus sku khams shin tu bsnyel ba rang gis sku mtshams dam por yod 'dug pa/ thog mar brda len 'phrod dka' tsam byung 'dug kyang thugs rjes 'phral du 'bul thub 'dug cing de ma thag bzhugs gdan las ldings bar yang gnang zhing*/ shin du dgyes pa chen pos da ni khams bde bar 'ong zhes bka' bstsal ba bzhin/ nyin re bzhin je dwangs la song*/ zhag bcu skor tsam nas sor chud/ bla ma nyid kyi thugs rjes dang*/ bdag cag gi mos pa dang*/ grub thob rnams kyi rten 'brel phyin ci ma logs pa'i rtags su snang ngo*//༈ mos gus an+da rnyil gyi me long du/ /ya mtshan gzugs brnyan ma 'gags 'dir shar te/ /rgyu rkyen legs par tshogs pa gang yin las/ /nges par 'bras mchog smin pa dngos po'i gshis/ /dbang bcu brnyes rnams gshin rje'i grong bcom nas/ /dus kyi nyin par gyur pa srid ma yin/ /baiḍūr sa gzhir lha dbang gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /dad pa'i sa gzhi rnyog bral ma bral khyod/ /de slad dad pa'i dbang po'i brtas pa las/ /zhabs pad yun ring 'tsho zhing gzhes pa 'dis/ /srid pa'i mun par dam chos nyi ma yi/ /bskal bzang gyur pa 'di las ngo mtshar gang*/ /zhes bshad sgrub kyis 'gro ba'i don bla lhag tu gyur pa dang*/ mos gus kyi mthu gsal bar bstan pa las brtsams te bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te bcu pa'o//
//de skabs bka' gnang la/ bdag la phag lo'i nang du cis kyang slebs par gyis zhes phebs pa blo la bzhags te/ phag lo'i nang du ci slebs kyi rtsa

ི sa byas rung*/ brel bas bag tsam 'gyangs te/ byi lo hor zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga la zhabs drung du slebs/ zhal mjal ma thag shin tu dgyes pa chen pos zhal 'dzum gyis bsu bar gnang byung bas/ dad pa dang dga' bas bskul ba'i lus sems bzung mi thub pa lta bus snang ba ban bun du 'gro ba zhig byung zhing*/ snga ma thams cad las kyang 'di skabs su lhag par thugs rjes bzungs/ chos dang gdams ngag zab dgu thams cad bka' drin du lhug par bstsal te/ dpal ri bo che'i gdan rabs nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ 'gro mgon phag gru'i bka' 'bum/ mgon po'i nyams khrid rgyab brten chos skor mtha' dag dang bcas pa bka' drin nod pas mchog tu tshim pa thob/ bdag sku drung du slebs tsa na sku khams cung zad dub pa zhig snang zhing*/ de mthun gyi bla ma nyid kyis bka' gnang khur len pa'i grub rgyal ma dang lha dgu ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ rnam 'joms kyi khrus byab sogs phul bas sku khams dwangs skyed shin tu che bar byung zhing*/ de rjes su brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs shig kyang phul bas rten 'brel shin tu legs shing*/ sku khams shin tu bzang bar byung*/ spyir nas rje rin po che 'di nyid sku bsnyel ba ltar ston pa 'di dag ni/ gzhan ngor rtogs pa khyad par can re mngon du gyur ba'i lhongs kyi tshul yin par snang bas/ sku bsnyun par gyur ba'i tshe zla ba mang por phyag rtsa rnams mi mngon pa sogs ni da lta'i skye bo rnams kyis rang blo dang bstun pa'i sna tshogs par gleng ba zhig yod na'ang*/ dngos gnas ni rtsa rnams dbu mar dag pa dang*/ rlung rnams thig ler thim pa'i mngon rtags khyad par can du snang la/ don dam par ni gzhan rnams kyis sku'i rim 'gro bgyid pa la sogs pas kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po spel ba'i slad du tshul de bzhin du ston par mdzad pa yin no/

/ bar skabs 'dir hor stod smad rnams kyi dpon rnams thams cad stag lung nyid du 'dzoms pa la/ legs bsgrigs kyi bka' bstsal yang dag par gnang*/ snga gong khyi lor zhig gsos kyi dgongs pa shar yang sde gzar la brten/ 'then pa gnang dgos shar/ slar 'di skabs phyag gi dngos po bung che ba zhal ngo so sor bstsal/ gling gi spyil bur zhig gsos gnang ste/ spyil bo brgya dang brgyad bzhengs/ mnga' zhabs la bu khral gnang dus btsun pa brgya nyi shu tsam rab tu 'byin par mdzad do/ /de nas dbyar stod de chab tshan la phebs pa dang*/ sku la shin tu 'jug par 'byung zhing*/ byang rigs kyi sems can rnams kyi 'gro ba'i don ci rigs par mdzad de/ slar yang gnas mchog dam pa nyid du phyag phebs/ 'di skabs bdag gis zhabs pad zla ba drug lhag tsam 'bral med du bsten/ gdam ngag zab mo lhug par stsal/ zab chos kyi glegs bam mang po'ang bdag la gnang ste/ rgya cher shod ces bka'i gnang ba byung*/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis bdag la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos 'jig rten ngo dang bstun pa'i bka' drin yang*/ tshe 'dir nam yang 'khor ba'i thabs med pa'i ji srid mngon par sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du gsob par bgyid cing*/ nam zhig mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho 'khor ba las bsgral ba de'i tshe skyabs gnas mthar thug dam pa khyed kyis bdag la bka' drin stsal pa thams cad kyi drin lan bsabs pa yin no snyams du sems mo/ /bdag gis ji ltar bka' drin du nod pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi sgo rnams ni gzhan du bris zin pas 'dir ma brjod do/ /'di skabs tho mis kyi rgyal brgyud du gtogs pa/ sog po'i rgyal po kha dan bag dur yang mjal zhing bka' chos kyi 'brel ba zhur byung*/ snga gong mjal ma myong 'dug na'ang mchog tu gus pa chen pos yid kyis gsol ba 'debs par snang*/

de nas bdag cag rnams sku gzhogs nas yong dus bzhugs gdan phul zhing*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba btab mchog tu dgyes pa chen pos 'tsho zhing bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i phyir 'phags pa'i tshig mi bslu ba yin pas/ bde ba dang yid bde ba bla na med pa thob par gyur to/ /gang zhig zhabs zung srid zhi'i skyabs gcig pu/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung dpal gyis mngon rgyas pa/ /'di nyid kho nas mtha' dag 'gro ba rnams/ /chos dang srid kyis skal bzang phun tshogs thob/ /'bum phrag rgyu skar yod dam med kyang bla/ /nyin byed mgon dang bcas na nyin mor gyur/ /srid gsum phun tshogs gzhan ni ci bder gyis/ /rgyal khyod mchog tu bstan pa'i bka' drin 'tshal/ /dpag yas rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*/ /bstan srung rnams kyang mgon po khyod nyid kyi/ / zhabs pad bsten pa'i thabs bzang mdzod cig ces/ /'di nyid kho na gsol ba gdab par bya/ /zhes pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa bden pa'i tshig gis zhal gyis 'ches pa las brtsams te bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te bcu gcig pa'o// //de bas na da lta bdag cag 'gro ba thams cad kyi mgon skyabs su zhabs pad brtan par gdan chags pa 'dis 'jig rten mtha' dag bskal pa bzang por gyur pa yin zha ི nga*/ da dung srid mtha'i bar du zhabs pad brtan nas bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ /'dir smras pa/ gang zhig mtha' dag rgyal ba'i gsang ba gsum/ / mgon po khyod kyi gsang gsum dkyil 'khor nyid/ /brjod bral bsam yas dpag par dka' ba 'di/ /gsung gi rdo rje can gyis brjod bya yin/ /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gser mngal can/ / tshig gi bdag mo dbyangs can la sogs kyang*/ /chu gter chen po skyal bas 'jug pa bzhin/ /cha shas tsam yang gzhal bar mi dpyod na/ /ma rig 'khrul 'khor rnams par 'khor ba yi/ /byis pa rmongs pa dag gis go skabs ci/

/'on kyang bskal mnyam gzhan la phan pa dang*/ /rang gi brjed byang tsam du bris pa 'dis/ /mgon po khyod kyi rnam thar yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur yang cis mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i bsod nams ni/ /nam mkha'i khams su shong ba min zha ེ sa gsungs/ /'dir brjod gang yin sems can spyi mthun la/ /dngos su snang ba kho nas cha tsam ste/ /chung ngur chen por bsngags pa'i sgro btags kyis/ /phul byung gtam gyis brjod pa lhur ma byas/ /kun gyis da lta mngon gsum mthong ba dang*/ /zhabs pad yun ring brtan pa mang ba'i phyir/ /bden rdzun rtags dpyad dngos su byar yod pas/ /brtags na kho bo'i tshig 'dir yid ches 'gyur/ / dpag yas rgyal ba rnams kyi rnam thar rgya la mtshor 'jug 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rnam par thar pa dal 'bab chu rgyun chad mi mnga'/ /de las mos blo'i snyims pas cung zad blangs ba'i 'gro la sbyin pa 'dis/ /'gro kun snying gi gdung ba bsal nas rgyal ba'i rnam thar cher 'jug shog /gzhan yang mtha' yas srid 'dir ma lus dge legs dpal gyi rol ba dang 'grogs pa'i/ /kun tu dge ba dang bcas phyogs las bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan can/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'gro 'di'i dpal mgon byang chub ye shes bzang po thob gyur nas/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stong bar du lhun 'grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las can/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rtag tu 'grub gyur cig /srid gsum rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /chos kyi rgyal srid dga' ston 'phel gyur cig /phyi nang phyogs kyi phan bde rgyas gyur cig /rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*/ /mgon po khyod kyis thugs rje las/ /srid gsum dge legs kun 'grub cing*/ /phan bde 'byor ba'i bkra shis shog /ces
